description: 逐句核对的译文与显示句对。articles 为整篇顺序核对；patches 为局部核对。英文改变必须重新审核，不得按长度猜配。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I am a brutally honest person.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我是个非常耿直的人。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: So I will let you in on a little secret.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 所以让我先告诉你一个小秘密。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Before I came to Manchester City, I didn’t really know what to make of this Raheem Sterling guy.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 在我到曼城之前，我真的不知道斯特林这家伙会是个什么样的人。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I had never met him, and from what I’d read about him in the English press, I thought he was going to be a very different character.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我从来没有见过他，根据我在英国媒体上读到关于他的种种，我以为他会是个完全不同的人。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I thought.…
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我以为…

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Well.…
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 嗯…

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I didn’t think he’d be a bad guy, really.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 说真的，我倒没觉得他会是个坏人。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: But the tabloids were always claiming that he was arrogant.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 但是媒体总是说他是如何的高傲自大之类的。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: So I guess I thought he’d be…
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 所以我就以为他会是…

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: what do the English call it?
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 英国人是怎么说来着？

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: A bit of a dickhead, maybe?
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 也许，有点“混蛋”？

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Raheem and I have this strong connection, because we arrived at City around the same time, and there was a lot of negativity about us in the press.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 拉希姆和我很有默契，因为我们差不多同时来到曼城，而且当时媒体上关于我们的负面报道很多。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: They said I was “the Chelsea reject.” They said Raheem was this flashy guy who left Liverpool for money.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 他们说我是‘切尔西弃将’。他们说拉希姆是个爱炫耀、为了钱离开利物浦的家伙。

alignedParts.en: They said I was “the Chelsea reject.”
alignedParts.cn: 他们说我是‘切尔西弃将’。

alignedParts.en: They said Raheem was this flashy guy who left Liverpool for money.
alignedParts.cn: 他们说拉希姆是个爱炫耀、为了钱离开利物浦的家伙。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: They said we were difficult characters.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 人们说我们俩是难相处的人。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Of course, when you read this stuff about yourself, you think, Me?
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 当然了，当你读到这些关于你自己的话，你会想：“我？

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I’m not difficult.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我不难搞啊。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: This is ridiculous.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 太可笑了吧。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: These people don’t even know me!
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 这些人根本就不认识我！

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: But honestly, when you read about other players, it influences the way you think.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 但是说实话，当你读到关于其他人的东西的时候，这些东西会对你的看法多少有些影响。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: You can’t help it.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 这是无法控制的。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Then I got to City and I actually met Raheem, and we’d talk a bit after training, and I thought, Wait, this guy seems really cool?
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 所以当我认识Raheem之后，我们在训练之后会聊聊天之类的，然后我想：“等等，这家伙挺酷的啊？

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: What’s the story here?
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 到底怎么回事？”

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Truthfully, I don’t have many close friends — inside or outside of football.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 说实话，无论是足球场上下，我没有特别多非常要好的朋友。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: It takes me a really long time to open up to people.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我是个慢热的人，总是需要很长时间才能对外人敞开心扉。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: But over time, I got closer to Raheem, because our sons were born around the same time, so they would always play together.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 慢慢地，我和Raheem变得更加要好，因为我们各自的儿子差不多同时出生，他们会经常一起玩耍。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I really got to know Raheem, and I recognized what a smart and genuine person he is.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 当我更加了解Raheem之后,我意识到他是多么聪明和真实的一个人。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: He couldn’t be more different from what the tabloids were saying.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 他简直和媒体上描述的太不一样了。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: This is the real truth: Raheem is one of the nicest, most humble guys I’ve met in football.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 这绝对是事实：Raheem是足球圈里面我见过的，最友好最谦虚的人之一。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Anyway, one day we were talking and Raheem said something like, “Mate, I thought you were going to be well different, before I met you.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 有一天，我们俩在聊天，然后Raheem说：“伙计，在遇见你之前，我以为你是个非常不同的一个人。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I thought you were going to be really distant and shy.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我以为你会很疏远、很害羞。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: But you’re actually quite funny.”
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 但其实你挺幽默的。”

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I said, “I have a dry humor.”
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我说：“我擅长冷幽默。”

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: He said, “ Well dry.”
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 他说：“确实，非常冷。”

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Then he said, “So what did you think I’d be like?”
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 然后他问“你当时觉得我会是什么样的？”

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I said, “Honestly?
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我说：“说实话？

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I thought you were going to be really arrogant!”
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我以为你会是特别高傲自大的一个人”

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: He looked at me like, “Mate!”
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 他瞪着我叫到：“你这家伙！”

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: And I looked at him like, “What?
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我也看着他说：“怎么了？

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: You thought I was going to be weird!”
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 你还不是觉得我会是个古怪的人么!”

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: It’s a great lesson, I think.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 这件事情是个很好的教训。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: In my experience, footballers can be a lot different than you expect, especially if you really get to know them.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 就我自己的经验，足球运动员们可能会和你想象的非常不一样，尤其是在你对他更加的了解之后。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: This is definitely true for me as well.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 就我自己而言，也是一样的。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I can understand why Raheem thought I was going to be difficult.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我能理解为什么Raheem会觉得我可能比较难相处。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Since I was 16 years old, there was a cloud that followed me around.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 从我16岁那年开始，就有这么个“乌云”似的东西压着我。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I’ll tell you the story, but please understand that talking about myself is pretty much the hardest thing in the world for me.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我来讲讲这个故事，但是请你理解，谈论我自己，对我来讲是世界上最困难的事情。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Football?
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 如果是聊足球？

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I could talk to you for hours about it.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我可以讲好几个小时。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: But anything personal, it’s tough for me.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 但是讲任何关于我个人的事情，对我来说都很难。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: It’s just my nature.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 这就是我的性格。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I’m sure some people reading can relate to this.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我相信在读这篇文章的一些人会有同感。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Since I was a boy, I’ve always been extremely quiet, extremely shy.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我从小就是个很安静，很害羞的人。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Didn’t have a PlayStation.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我没有过PlayStation游戏机。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Didn’t have many close friends.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 没有什么要好的朋友。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: The way that I expressed myself was through football, and I was very content with that.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 但是能通过足球表达自己，对我来说已经心满意足。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Off the pitch, I was very introverted.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 足球场下，我是个很内向的人。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I wouldn’t say one word to you.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我一句话都不会跟你说。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: But on the pitch, I was so flammable.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 但到了球场上，我却一点就着。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I know everyone had a laugh about that clip of me yelling at David Silva to “LET ME TALK!” and all that.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我知道很多人都觉得那个我冲着大卫席尔瓦喊“听我说！”的视频很搞笑。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: But that’s probably quite tame compared to when I was a kid.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 但是说实话那个视频里面的我和我小时候的脾气，根本没法比。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: When you’re young…
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 年轻的时候……

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: well, you don’t understand that people can take it the wrong way.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 嗯，你不明白别人可能会误解你。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I learned this the hard way, for sure.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 而我也是经历了很多,才慢慢明白这一点。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: When I was 14, I made a decision that really changed my life.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我14岁的时候，做了一个改变我人生的决定。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I had the opportunity to go to the football academy in Genk, so I moved by myself from one side of Belgium to the other.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 当时有个加入Genk俱乐部训练营的机会，所以我当时从比利时的一端搬到了另外一端。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: It was two hours away from home, but I told my parents that I wanted to go.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 虽然离家2个小时，但是我还是告诉我的父母我想去。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: The problem was that I was already shy in my hometown.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 问题是，即使在家乡，我也已经很害羞了。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: At Genk, I was the new kid from the other side of the country who spoke in a funny dialect.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 到了亨克，我更是一个从国家另一头来的新孩子，还说着奇怪的方言。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: It was lonely, for sure.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 当时确实很孤独。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I didn’t really learn to have a social life, because the only day we had off was Sunday, and that was my opportunity to travel home to see my family.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我没怎么学会与人交往，因为我们只有周日休息，而那是我回家探望家人的机会。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: So my first two years at the academy were probably the loneliest years I’ll ever live.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 所以，在青训营的头两年，可能是我一生中最孤独的两年。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Maybe some people will think this was all a bit crazy, like, Why would you even do this at 14 years old?
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 也许有些人会觉得这很难理解，你才14岁，为什么要这么做呢？

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: The only answer I can give you is that when I was playing football, everything went away.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我能解释的就是，当我踢球的时候，所有其他的东西都消失不见了。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Any problem I had, anything I was feeling, it all disappeared.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 所有烦恼、所有情绪，都会消失。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: When I’m playing football, everything is good.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 只要在踢球，一切就都很好。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: If you want to call it an obsession, then maybe it is my obsession.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 如果你想把这称作痴迷，那也许它就是我的痴迷。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Quite simply, it is my life.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 简单地说，足球就是我的生命。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: The first year, I lived in a boarding house, where I had this tiny room with a bed and a desk and a sink.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 第一年，我住在宿舍里，房间很小，里面只有一张床、一张桌子和一个洗手池。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: The next year, I was able to live with a foster family that the club paid to take in young players.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 第二年，我得以住进一个寄宿家庭，俱乐部付钱请他们照顾年轻球员。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Me and two other players moved in with them, and it helped me live a more normal life.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我和另外两个球员搬入了那个家，那让我能够过上更加正常的生活。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I still stayed by myself most of the time, but I thought everything was O.K.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我仍然独来独往，但是我没觉得有任何问题。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: The year went by, and I was doing well in school, doing well in football.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 一年过去了，我在学校表现不错，球也踢得很好。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: No fights.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 没有打架。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: No problems.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 没有惹麻烦。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: At the end of the year, I packed my bags and said goodbye to my foster family.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 学年结束时，我收拾好行李，向寄宿家庭道别。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: They said, “We’ll see you after the break.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 他们说：“假期结束后再见。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Have a good summer.”
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 祝你暑假愉快。”

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: But then as soon as I got back to my parents’ house, I walked in the door and could see that my mother was crying.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 但回到父母家时，我刚进门，就看见母亲在哭。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I thought maybe somebody had died or something.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我还以为有人去世了，或者出了类似的事。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I said, “What’s the problem?”
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我问：“怎么了？”

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: And my mother said the words that probably shaped my whole life.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 然后，母亲说出了那句可能塑造了我整个人生的话。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: She said, “They don’t want you to come back.”
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 她说：“他们不想让你回去了。”

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I said, “What are you talking about?”
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我说：“你在说什么？”

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: She said, “The foster family don’t want you there anymore.”
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 她说：“那个寄宿家庭不想再让你住在那里了。”

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I said, “What?
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我说：“什么？

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Why?”
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 为什么？”

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: She said, “Because of who you are.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 她说：“因为你的性格。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: They said you’re too quiet.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 他们说你太安静了。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: They can’t interact with you.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 没办法和你互动。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: They said you were difficult.”
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 他们说你太难相处了。”

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I was really shocked.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我很惊讶。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: It felt like such a personal thing.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 那感觉是个非常私人的问题。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: The family never said anything to my face.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 寄宿家庭从来没有当我面提起过。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: There was never any problems.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我从没觉得有什么问题。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I stayed to myself in my room.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我只是呆在自己的房间里面。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I never bothered anyone.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 不招惹任何人。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: They waved goodbye to me like everything was fine.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 他们刚刚还和没事人一样和我道别。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: And then they informed the club that they didn’t want me anymore.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 结果他们却和俱乐部说他们不再要我了。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: It was actually a huge issue for my career, because I was not a big star or anything, and suddenly the club thought I was a problem.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 这一下子成为了我的足球生涯中很大的一个难题，因为我本来就不是俱乐部的尖子，这下子俱乐部还会觉得我这个人有问题。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: They informed my parents that they didn’t want to pay for another foster family.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 所以他们告诉我的父母，他们不愿意花钱再为我找另外一个寄宿家庭了。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I was going to have to go to another boarding house and live there — and not like a fancy one.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我必须要去住另外一个宿舍，而且还不是一个很好的一个宿舍。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: It was more like a place for troubled kids.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 那是为问题孩子准备的宿舍。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I remember watching my mom crying, and just grabbing the ball.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我记得自己看着母亲哭，然后抓起了足球。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I went outside to this fence where I’d always played by myself as a kid.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我走到屋外，来到那道栅栏旁，小时候我总是一个人在那里踢球。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: One thing really stuck with me.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 有一句话让我久久无法忘记。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: “Because of who you are.”
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: “因为你这个人。”

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: The words kept repeating in my head.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 那些话一直在我脑海里反复回响。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I kicked the ball against the fence for hours, and I remember at some point I actually said out loud, “Everything is going to be O.K.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我冲着栅栏踢了很久的球，我记得自己还对自己说：“没事的。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: In two months, I’m going to be in the first team.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 两个月后，我就能到一队。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: No matter what, I am not coming back home a failure.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 无论如何，我都不会以一个失败者的身份回到家。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: No matter what.”
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 不会的。”

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I went back to Genk after the summer break, and I had just been moved up to the second team.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 暑假之后我回到Genk, 当时我刚刚被升到二队。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I was a nobody, really.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我是个无名小卒，真的。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: But I was training like…
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 但是我当时拼了命的训练…

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: pfffff.
I had so much fire inside me.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我心里面充满了斗志。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: It was mad.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 简直像疯了一样。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I remember the exact moment everything changed.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我清晰的记得那个改变一切的时刻。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: We played on a Friday night.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我们周五晚上有场比赛。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I started on the bench.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我一开始是在替补席上。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: When I came on in the second half, I just went crazy.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 下半场我上场之后，我整个人都疯狂了。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: One goal.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 然后，我踢进了…第一个进球。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: They don’t want you anymore.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: “他们不要你了…”

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Two goals.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 第二个进球。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Too quiet.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: “你太安静了…”

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Three goals.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 第三个进球。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Too difficult.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: “你太难相处了…”

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Four goals.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 第四个进球。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: They don’t want you anymore.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: “他们不要你了…”

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Five goals.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 第五个进球。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Because of who you are.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: “因为你这个人…”

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I scored five goals in one half.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我在半场进了5个球。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: After that, you could see the change in everybody around the club.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 那之后，你能看到俱乐部所有人的改变。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I earned a spot on the first team within two months.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 两个月之内，我进了一队。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I think I beat my goal by a few days.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 好像比我自己的目标早了几天。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: And then, of course, the club told my family that they wanted to pay for a foster family again.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 很显然那个时候，俱乐部也给我的父母打电话说他们会付钱再给我找一个寄宿家庭。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: It’s funny to see the change in how people treat you in football when you’re doing well.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 在足球中，当你表现出色的时候人们对你的态度的转变，真的很可笑。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: One day, the foster parents actually showed up at the club, and the woman came up to me like everything was a big misunderstanding.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 有一天，我之前的那个寄宿家庭的夫妇来到了俱乐部，那个女士表现的好像一切都是一个很大的误会似的。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: She said something like, “We wanted you to come back!
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 她说什么“我们想要你回到我们家里！

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: We just wanted you to go to the boarding house during the week!
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我们当时只是想让你周一到周五去宿舍！

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: You can stay with us on weekends!”
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 周末你可以住到家里来啊！”

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Maybe I should’ve found it funny, but at the time it wasn’t funny to me.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 也许我本该觉得好笑，但当时我一点也笑不出来。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: They had really hurt me.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 他们确实深深伤害了我。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: So I said, “No.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 所以我说：“不。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: You threw me in the garbage.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 你们曾把我像垃圾一样扔掉。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Now I’m doing well and you want me back?”
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 现在我表现好了，你们又想让我回去？”

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: In the end, I should have just said thank you.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 其实，我似乎应该就说一句谢谢。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: That experience was the fuel for my career.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 那个经历是改变我职业生涯的助力。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: But, unfortunately, that cloud still followed me around for a long time.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 但是同时，那件事情也像乌云一样压抑了我很长时间。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: When I was a young player at Genk, and even when I signed for Chelsea, you would read stories in the Belgian press about how I was a difficult person, and they would always bring up the story of my foster family.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 当我成为Genk的一名年轻球员，甚至是签约切尔西之后，你都能在比利时的媒体上读到我是多么难相处的一个人，然后关于我和寄宿家庭的这个故事，总是被提及。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: It’s true that I can blow up sometimes, especially on the pitch.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 确实，有的时候我在场上会发脾气。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I tend to hold things inside, and then bang — I lose my head.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我通常都把事情憋在心里，然后突然一下子都释放出来。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Usually five seconds later, I’m calm again.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 5秒钟之后，我又会冷静下来。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: But I feel a little bit misunderstood.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 总之有的时候我会觉得被误解。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Everything I’ve ever done in football really comes down to one thing — I want to play.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我所做的关乎足球的一切，其实都归根结底于一个事情：我想要踢球。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: When I was at Chelsea, there was so much in the press about my relationship with José Mourinho.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我在切尔西的时候，关于我和穆里尼奥的关系总是会有很多报道。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: But the truth is that I only ever spoke to him twice.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 但是事情的真相是，我总共只和他说过两次话。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: The plan was always for me to go on loan for a bit.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 本来计划就是我会被租借出去一段时间。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: So I went to Werder Bremen in 2012, and that season went great.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 所以我在2012年去了不来梅，而且那个赛季很不错。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: When I came back to Chelsea the next summer, a few German clubs wanted to sign me.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 那个夏天我回到切尔西的时候，有好几个德国的俱乐部想要我。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Klopp wanted me to come to Borussia Dortmund, and they played the kind of football that I enjoy.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: Klopp想要我去多特蒙德，而且他们的打法是我很喜欢的。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: So I thought maybe Chelsea would let me go.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 所以我想着可能切尔西会让我去。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: But then Mourinho texted me, “You are staying.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 但随后穆里尼奥给我发短信：“你要留下来。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I want you to be part of this team.”
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我希望你成为这支球队的一员。”

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: So I thought, O.K., great.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 于是我想：“这很好。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I’m in his plans.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我在他的计划中。”

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: When I arrived for preseason, the vibe was good.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 赛季前报到的之后，一开始整个气氛都很不错。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I started two of the first four games of the season, and I thought I played O.K.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 赛季前四场比赛，我有两场首发，我觉得自己踢得还可以。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Not brilliant, but pretty good.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 算不上出色，但也挺不错。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: After the fourth game, that was it.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 第四场比赛之后，一切就戛然而止了。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I was on the bench, and I never really got a chance again.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我开始在替补席上，然后就再没有得到什么机会。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I didn’t get an explanation.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我也没有得到任何的解释。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I was just out of favor for some reason.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我就一下子不在考虑之中了。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: And, of course, I made some mistakes myself.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 当然了，我自己也有很多失误。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I was a bit naive about the way that you have to handle yourself as a Premier League footballer.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我当时对如何做一个英超球员，有着很天真的想法。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: What I think most fans don’t realize is that when you’re out of favor at a club, you don’t get nearly the same attention during training.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我想，大多数球迷不知道的是：当你在俱乐部失宠时，训练中得到的关注也会大大减少。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: At some clubs, it’s like you don’t exist anymore.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 在有些俱乐部，你简直像是不存在了。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: If it happened to me now, it wouldn’t be a problem.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 如果这发生在现在的我身上，可能不会是大的问题。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I know enough to be able to train on my own and take care of myself.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我现在知道如何自己训练和照顾自己。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: But when you’re 21, you don’t understand what it takes.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 但是当你21岁的时候，对这一切并不太明白。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: When I got another chance to play, against Swindon Town in the Cup, I wasn’t in good shape.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 当我在杯赛对阵Swindon Town 又得到一个上场机会的时候，我本身状态并不好。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: And then that was pretty much it for me.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 然后那之后，一切基本就结束了。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: José called me into his office in December, and it was probably the second big life-changing moment for me.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 穆里尼奥在12月的时候把我叫到办公室，那可能是我这辈子第二个重大的时刻。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: He had some papers in front of him, and he said, “One assist.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 他面前放了一些纸，念道：“1次助攻。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Zero goals.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 0进球。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Ten recoveries.”
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 10次反抢。”

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: It took me a minute to understand what he was doing.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我过了一阵才反应过来他在说什么。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Then he started reading the stats of the other attacking forwards — Willian, Oscar, Mata, Schürrle.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 然后，他开始念其他进攻球员的数据——威廉、奥斯卡、马塔、许尔勒。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: And it’s like — five goals, 10 assists, whatever.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 大概是五个进球、十次助攻之类的。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: José was just kind of waiting for me to say something, and finally I said, “But…
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 穆里尼奥一直等着我说点什么，终于我开口说 “但是…

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: some of these guys have played 15, 20 games.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 他们踢了15，20场球。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I’ve only played three.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我才踢了3场。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: So it’s going to be different, no?”
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 所以这没法比较，不是吗？

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: It was so strange.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 那真是个奇怪的时刻。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: We had a bit of a conversation about me going back out on loan.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我们讨论了一下我再次被租借出去之类的。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: And Mata was also out of favor at the time, so José said, “Well, you know, if Mata leaves, then you will be the fifth choice instead of sixth.”
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 当时Mata似乎也不太被看好，所以穆里尼奥说：“如果Mata离开，那你就是我的前锋第五选择，而不是第六个。”

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I was completely honest.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我说得非常坦率。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I said, “I feel like the club doesn’t really want me here.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我说：“我感觉俱乐部并不是真的想留下我。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I want to play football.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我想要踢球。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I’d rather you sell me.”
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我宁愿你把我卖掉。”

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I think José was a bit disappointed, but to be fair to him, I think he also understood that I absolutely needed to play.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我想当时穆里尼奥可能有些失望，但是公平地讲，他可能也明白我必须要得到上场踢球的机会。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: So the club ended up selling me, and there was no big problem at all.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 球队最后把我交易出去了，这一切并没有什么大问题。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Chelsea got more than double the price they paid for me, and I got into a much better situation at Wolfsburg.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 切尔西得到的转会费，比当初买下我时花的钱的两倍还多；而我在沃尔夫斯堡的处境也好了很多。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Everything changed then.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 所有一切就在那个时候改变了。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: But not just because of football.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 但并不仅仅是足球生涯上的改变。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: It was also because I had my (future) wife by my side.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 而是那个时候我还得到了（未来的）妻子的陪伴。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: She helped me grow in ways that I’ve probably never expressed out loud — even to her.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 她在许多方面帮助我成长，而这些我大概从未说出口——甚至没有亲口对她说过。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: This is such an embarrassing story that I hesitate to tell it!
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 这个故事实在太让人脸红了，我真的不太想说。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: But since I promised you honesty, then I guess I have to.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 不过，既然答应了要坦诚，我想就得讲出来。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: And it’s pretty funny, anyway.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 反正这个故事也挺好笑的。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: It started with a tweet.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 一切始于一条推文。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I only had a few thousand followers at the time, because I was still on loan at Werder Bremen.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 当时我只有几千个粉丝，因为我还被租借在云达不来梅。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: So I tweeted something about a match or whatever, and this pretty girl favorited it.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我发了一条关于比赛的推特，然后这个漂亮的姑娘点了赞。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I was single at the time, and my friend noticed it.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我当时正好单身，然后我的朋友看到了。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: So he said, “She looks like a nice girl, no?
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 他说，“她看起来是个不错的女孩不是吗？

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: You should send her a message.”
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 你应该给她发个消息。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: And I literally said to him, “No, no, no.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我当时真的对他说：“不，不，不。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Come on.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 别闹了。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: People don’t like me.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 大家都不喜欢我。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: They don’t get me.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 他们不理解我。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: She won’t respond.”
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 她不会回复我的。”

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: So he grabbed my phone and started tapping out a message.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 结果他抓起我的电话，开始编辑一段信息。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: He showed me the phone and said, “Come on, can I hit send?”
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 他把手机给我看，说：“来吧，我能点发送了吗？”

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I was probably on the floor, cringing, but for some reason I said, “O.K.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我大概已经尴尬得倒在地上了，可不知为什么，我还是说：“好吧。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: fine, send it.”
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 行，发吧。”

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Says it all, no?
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 这就说明一切了，不是吗？

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I’m supposed to be this big footballer, and I didn’t even have the heart to slide into my future wife’s DMs!
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我好歹也算个有名的球员，居然连给未来的妻子发条私信的勇气都没有！

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I didn’t dare!
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我真的没有胆！

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: But thankfully, he sent the message for me, and she responded.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 庆幸的是，我的朋友帮我发了那条信息，而且她回复了。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: We got to know each other over text for a few months.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我们在接下来几个月短信交流中了解了彼此。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: It’s a lot easier for me once I get to know someone, so after that, I was good.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 对我来说，当我对别人有了一定的了解之后，我会放松很多。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: It really was a beautiful thing.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 这是一个美好的故事。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: She changed my life in so many ways.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 她改变了我的人生。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Honestly, I don’t know what I would do without her.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我不知道没有她，我该怎么办。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: People throw around this label of “WAGs,” and I think it’s really a shame.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 人们总是用这个“WAGs”这个词，我觉得这个标签让人感觉不太好。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Because my wife, she’s the most important person in my life.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我的妻子，她是我生命中最最重要的人。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: She sacrificed everything to move away with me when she was 19 years old, to help me follow my dream.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 她在19岁的时候牺牲了一切和我一起搬到远方，为了我能追寻自己的梦想。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: We’ve been on this journey together.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我们一直同舟共济。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I look up to her, in a way.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 在某种程度上来讲，我很敬佩她。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: She got me to come out of my shell with people a lot, and the way she’s handled everything is remarkable, really.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 她让我能够在外人面前放开很多，还有她面对一切的方式，我觉得非常的佩服，真的。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: We had just found out that she was pregnant with our first child during the transfer window in 2015.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 2015年转会期的时候，我们刚刚得知她怀了我们的第一个孩子。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Manchester City, PSG and Bayern were all interested in me.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 曼城，巴黎圣日尔曼，还有拜仁当时都对我感兴趣。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: It was an extremely stressful time.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 那是个很令人紧张的一段时间。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: We were just starting our family, and we had no idea whether the transfer would go through, or where we’d be living.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我们刚刚开始组建自己的家庭，但是我们不知道转会是否会成功，也不知道我们会在哪里安家。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Personally, I wanted to go to City.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我个人来讲，我想要去曼城。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I had Vinny Kompany texting me, telling me all about the project, saying that I would love it.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 当时Vinny Kompany发短信给我，给我讲了很多球队的计划，他说我一定会喜欢的。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: And I just felt really good about the club.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我当时就对球队的印象和感觉非常好。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: But I also didn’t want to be disrespectful to Wolfsburg because I genuinely loved my time there.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 但是我也不想对沃尔夫斯堡队有任何的不尊重，因为我真心的很享受我在那里的时光。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: So I just tried to shut my mouth and wait.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 所以我决定不要多说什么，静静的等待。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Easy for me!
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 这对我来说倒很容易！

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Every single day, literally for three weeks, my agent was saying, “It’s on.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 整整三个星期，每一天，我的经纪人都在说：“转会有戏。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Wait, it’s off.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 哦不，好像不行。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: It’s on.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 哦，没问题了。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Wait, it’s off again.”
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 哦不，好像又不行了。”

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: The stress really had an effect on my wife.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 那段时间的紧张对我妻子的影响不小。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: One morning we woke up and she was really, really ill.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 有一天早晨我们醒来，她当时病的很厉害。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: We didn’t know what to do.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我们不知道该怎么办。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: We were worried that maybe there was something wrong with the baby.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 很担心也许是孩子出了什么问题。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Then she was in a lot of pain, and she was bleeding.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 然后她疼痛难耐，开始流血。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: We had no idea what was happening, so we rushed to the hospital.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我们不知道到底发生了什么，所以赶紧去了医院。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: We were worried that maybe she’d lost the baby.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我们很担心也许我们会失去这个孩子。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: It was the worst moment of my life, no question.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 那绝对是我这辈子最难过的时刻。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: You’re just sitting there, helpless.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 因为你只能无助的坐在那里。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: One minute, all you’re thinking about is a football transfer.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 前一分钟，你还在担心足球俱乐部转会的事情。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: And then, all of a sudden, your world is upside down.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 下一分钟，你的整个世界都要坍塌了。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Thank God, in the end, everything was O.K.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 谢天谢地，最后一切都没事。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: with our son.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我们的儿子平安无事。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I don’t know what I would’ve done without him in my life.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 如果生命中没有他，我不知道自己会怎么办。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Everything good that’s ever happened to me in football, it’s nothing compared to my wife and my kids.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我在足球生涯里遇到过的所有美好事情，都无法与妻子和孩子相比。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: That was the third life-changing moment for me, because it made me realize that football is not life or death.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 那是第三个改变我人生的时刻，因为它让我意识到，足球并不是生死攸关的事。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I think I was probably too consumed by football for the first 23 years of my life.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我觉得在我前23年的生命中，对于足球太过于痴迷了。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: But when I met my wife, and especially after our first son was born, I was not doing it alone anymore.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 当我遇见我的妻子之后，尤其是我们的第一个儿子出生之后，我明白我并不是一个人在奋斗了。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: When we started our family and I came to play for City, everything just took off.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 当我们组建家庭、我来到曼城踢球之后，一切都开始腾飞。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Especially when Pep arrived that second season.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 尤其是当Pep在第二年来到曼城之后.

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Pep and I share a similar mentality.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: Pep和我的思想很接近。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: To be fair, he’s even more intense about football than I am.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 说实话，他比我对足球更加的痴迷。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: He’s so, so stressed — all the time.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 他真的每时每刻，都非常非常的紧绷。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: However much mental stress we are under as players, I think he is under twice as much.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 无论我们作为一个球员有着多少的思想压力，他可能承受的是双倍的压力。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Because he is not just interested in winning.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 因为他不仅仅是想要赢球。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: He wants perfection.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 他还追逐完美。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: The first meeting I ever had with Pep, he sat me down and he said, “Kevin, listen.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我记得我和Pep的第一次会面，他让我坐下来，说道：Kevin 你听着。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: You can be — easily — a top five player in the world.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 你完全可以——轻轻松松地——成为世界前五的球员。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Top five.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 世界前五。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Easily.”
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 轻轻松松。”

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I was shocked.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我惊讶极了。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: But when Pep said it with so much belief, it changed my whole mentality.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 但是当Pep以一种令人信服的口吻说出那些话的时候，我的整个思想都被改变了。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: It was kind of genius, I think.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 真的是非常天才的做法。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Because I felt like I had to prove him right, instead of prove him wrong.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 因为那之后我很想要证明他是正确的，而不是证明他是错误的。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Most of the time, football is about negativity and fear.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 很多时候，足球充满了负面情绪和恐惧。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: But with Pep, it’s about extreme positivity.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 但在佩普这里，一切都极其积极。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: He sets goals that are so high that they’re almost impossible to reach.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 他设定的目标高得几乎不可能实现。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: He is a tactical master, yes.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 没错，他是战术大师。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: There’s no doubt about this.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 这一点毫无疑问。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: But what people on the outside don’t see is the pressure he puts on himself to try to achieve perfection.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 但是外界的人们看不到为了追逐完美他给自己的压力有多大。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: This season has not been easy for me.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 这个赛季对我来说并不容易。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: The injuries and the matches that I’ve missed have been extremely difficult for me, mentally.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 伤病和缺席比赛对我来说是非常痛苦的事情。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Sitting and watching a match from the stands is basically worse than torture for me.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 坐在场下观看比赛对我来说简直比酷刑还难过。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I can’t cope.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我真的受不了。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Actually, my wife says that there’s something wrong with me.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我妻子说我这个人好像有点问题。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: We’ve been together almost seven years, and she had never seen me cry.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 因为我们在一起7年了，但是她从来没有见到我哭。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Even at funerals, I don’t cry.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 就算是在葬礼上，我也不会流泪。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: But then earlier this season, I injured my knee against Fulham, and there was some ligament damage.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 但在这个赛季早些时候，我在对富勒姆的比赛中伤了膝盖，韧带也有损伤。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: The doctors told me that I was going to have to be in a brace for a bit.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 医生告诉我，得佩戴一段时间的支具。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: This is always a nightmare, when you can’t even put on your underwear without help.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 连内衣都没有办法自己穿上，是个噩梦般的事情。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: But this was really terrible timing, because my wife had just given birth to our second son the day before.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 而且时机简直不能更加糟糕了，因为我的妻子在前一天才刚刚生了我们第二个儿子。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Actually, she had just arrived home from the hospital when I called her on FaceTime to tell her the news.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 实际上，在我打电话告诉她我受伤的时候，她才刚刚从医院回到家。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I said, “How’s the baby?
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我说：“孩子怎么样？

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: How’s everything?”
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 一切都好吧？

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: She said, “Everything is fine.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 她说：“一切都好。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Are you crying?”
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 你在哭吗？”

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I had a little tear in my eye, I guess.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我当时可能眼里有些泪水。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I said, “Well, I have some bad news.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我说：“我有个坏消息。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: It’s my knee again.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我的膝盖又受伤了。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I’m going to be in a brace for a while.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我要带固定器一段时间。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: So I guess you’re going to have to take care of three babies now.”
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 所以你要照顾三个婴儿了。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: And then, literally, I broke down in tears.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 然后，真的，我一下子哭了出来。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I couldn’t help it.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 无法控制般的。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I don’t know if it was the emotion of our son being born, or knowing that I was going to miss some more matches, or maybe both.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我不知道是因为我们的儿子的出生我太感动了，还是因为我知道我会错过很多比赛，或者两者都有。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: But I’m on FaceTime, on that stupid front-facing camera, looking ridiculous, just sobbing.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 不管因为什么，那个时候我冲着那可恶的前置摄像头，很难堪的抽泣着。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: My wife couldn’t believe it.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我的妻子简直不敢相信她的眼睛。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: She was like, “You didn’t even cry at our wedding!
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 她说：“我们的婚礼上你都没哭！

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: You didn’t even cry when your sons were born!
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 你儿子们出生的时候你都没哭过！

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: One was born literally YESTERDAY!”
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 有一个昨天才出生，昨天！”

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I think that says it all, really.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 这可能胜过千言万语吧。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Weddings, funerals, births?
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 婚礼、葬礼、孩子出生？

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: It’s nothing.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 都没什么。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I’m a rock.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我坚如磐石。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: But if you take football away from me?
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 但要是你不让我踢球？

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Forget it.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 那就别提了。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: I can’t cope.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 我受不了。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: In the end, this project at City is about more than winning.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 说到底，曼城的这项事业，意义不只是赢球。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: It’s about a certain way of playing and an overall philosophy.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 它关乎一种特定的踢球方式，以及一整套足球理念。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: This is why we get up every morning, why we obsess over so much detail in our work, why we try to push ourselves to the limits.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 这就是我们每天早晨睁开眼的动力，这就是为什么我们对每一个细节都那么在意，这就是为什么我们将自己推到极限。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: To play simple football is actually the hardest thing in the world.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 能够踢简单无杂物的足球，实际上是这个世界上最难的事情。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: But when it’s rolling?
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 但是当我们进入这个状态？

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: For me, it’s the most joy that I can have in life.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 对我来说，就是生命中最大的幸福感。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: So whether or not we achieve the impossible, this wave we’ve been on — it should be appreciated by anyone who truly loves football, I think.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 无论我们能否实现那些不可能，我们正在经历的这股势头，每一个喜欢足球的人都应该珍惜和享受。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: When we play our best at City, when we’re fluid it’s like…
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 当我们在曼城发挥出最佳水平，踢得行云流水时，就像……

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: what’s the word for it?
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 那个词怎么说来着？

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: You know, when you meditate?
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 你知道，就是冥想时的那种感觉？

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Nirvana.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 涅槃。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: It’s really like nirvana for me.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 就像涅磐重生一样。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: And I guess I’m a bit of a different kind of person, in that way, expressing myself mostly through football.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 好吧，我可能确实是个不太一样的一个人，大部分时候，我只通过足球来表达自己。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: But that’s my story.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 但是这就是我的故事。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Thanks for letting me tell it.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 谢谢你们让我来讲我自己的故事。

fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.en: Thanks for letting me talk.
fb-kevin-de-bruyne-let-me-talk.cn: 谢谢你们听我说。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: (I wrote this talk for a high school.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: （我给一个高中写了这篇文章。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: I never actually gave it, because the school authorities vetoed the plan to invite me.)
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 但我没真正去演讲过，因为学校负责人取消了邀请我）

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: When I said I was speaking at a high school, my friends were curious.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 当我说我要去一个高中演讲时，我的朋友们都很好奇。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: What will you say to high school students?
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 你会跟高中生说些什么？

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: So I asked them, what do you wish someone had told you in high school?
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 所以，我问他们，你会希望你在高中的时候有人能告诉你什么？

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Their answers were remarkably similar.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 他们的答案惊人的相似。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: So I'm going to tell you what we all wish someone had told us.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 所以我将要告诉你们，我们都希望有人能早点告诉我们的东西。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: I'll start by telling you something you don't have to know in high school: what you want to do with your life.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 开始的时候，先告诉你在高中并不需要知道的东西：你以后打算干什么？

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: People are always asking you this, so you think you're supposed to have an answer.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 人们总是这样问你，所以你想你要有个答案。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: But adults ask this mainly as a conversation starter.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 但成年人大多数这样问主要是为了挑起话头。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: They want to know what sort of person you are, and this question is just to get you talking.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 他们想知道你是什么样的人，这个问题只是为了让你开口。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: They ask it the way you might poke a hermit crab in a tide pool, to see what it does.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 他们这样问，就像你拨弄潮池里的一只寄居蟹，想看看它会有什么反应。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: If I were back in high school and someone asked about my plans, I'd say that my first priority was to learn what the options were.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 如果我回到高中，有人问起我的未来计划，我会说，我首要的事情就是去弄懂有哪些选择。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: You don't need to be in a rush to choose your life's work.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 你不必急于选择一辈子的事业。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: What you need to do is discover what you like.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 你需要做的是发现你喜爱的是什么。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: You have to work on stuff you like if you want to be good at what you do.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 如果你希望把你的事业做好的话，你不得不去做你喜欢的事情。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: It might seem that nothing would be easier than deciding what you like, but it turns out to be hard, partly because it's hard to get an accurate picture of most jobs.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 这看起来没有什么比发现自己喜爱的事情还更简单了，但事实上很困难，一部分原因是对大多数职业你很难有个准确的认识。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Being a doctor is not the way it's portrayed on TV.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 医生的工作，并不像电视里描绘的那样。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Fortunately you can also watch real doctors, by volunteering in hospitals. [1]
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 幸好，你可以去医院做志愿者，观察真正的医生。[1]

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: But there are other jobs you can't learn about, because no one is doing them yet.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 但有一些其它的工作你是没法了解的，因为还没有人去从事呢。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Most of the work I've done in the last ten years didn't exist when I was in high school.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 在过去十年里我大部分所干的工作，在我高中的时候压根还没有出现。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: The world changes fast, and the rate at which it changes is itself speeding up.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 世界变化得很快，同时变化的速率也在加快。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: In such a world it's not a good idea to have fixed plans.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 在这样的世界里，有确定的计划并不是好主意。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: And yet every May, speakers all over the country fire up the Standard Graduation Speech, the theme of which is: don't give up on your dreams.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 然而每年五月，全国各地的演讲者都会开始发表那套标准毕业演说，主题就是：不要放弃梦想。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: I know what they mean, but this is a bad way to put it, because it implies you're supposed to be bound by some plan you made early on.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 我知道他们想要表达什么意思，但这样表达很糟糕，因为这暗示了你应该固定在一个很早就想好了的计划。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: The computer world has a name for this: premature optimization.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 计算机的世界对此有个专业的词：过早优化。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: And it is synonymous with disaster.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 它几乎是灾难的同义词。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: These speakers would do better to say simply, don't give up.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 这些演说家还不如简简单单地说“不要放弃”来得更好呢。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: What they really mean is, don't get demoralized.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 他们真正的意思是：不要消沉意志。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Don't think that you can't do what other people can.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 不要认为你不能做到别人能做到的事情。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: And I agree you shouldn't underestimate your potential.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 我同意你不应该低估你的潜能。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: People who've done great things tend to seem as if they were a race apart.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 做出伟大事业的人看起来像是另一种人类。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: And most biographies only exaggerate this illusion, partly due to the worshipful attitude biographers inevitably sink into, and partly because, knowing how the story ends, they can't help streamlining the plot till it seems like the subject's life was a matter of destiny, the mere unfolding of some innate genius.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 大多数传记只会加深这种错觉：一方面，传记作者难免陷入崇拜；另一方面，由于已经知道结局，他们会不自觉地简化情节，直到主人公的一生看起来仿佛命中注定，不过是某种与生俱来的天才逐渐展开。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: In fact I suspect if you had the sixteen year old Shakespeare or Einstein in school with you, they'd seem impressive, but not totally unlike your other friends.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 事实上，如果16岁的莎士比亚或爱因斯坦和你一个学校，我怀疑他们看起来可能令人印象深刻，但并不完全和你的其他朋友不一样。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Which is an uncomfortable thought.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 这多么令人不安。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: If they were just like us, then they had to work very hard to do what they did.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 如果他们和你我一样，那他们不得不付出极大的努力去取得他们的成就。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: And that's one reason we like to believe in genius.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 这也是我们喜欢相信天才存在的一个原因。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: It gives us an excuse for being lazy.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 它给了我们偷懒的借口。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: If these guys were able to do what they did only because of some magic Shakespeareness or Einsteinness, then it's not our fault if we can't do something as good.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 如果这些人能取得成就，只是因为某种神奇的“莎士比亚特质”或“爱因斯坦特质”，那么我们做不到同样好，就不是我们的错。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: I'm not saying there's no such thing as genius.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 我不是在说世上完全没有天才这种东西。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: But if you're trying to choose between two theories and one gives you an excuse for being lazy, the other one is probably right.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 但如果你必须从两个理论中做出选择，一个理论给你懒惰的理由，那么另外一个理论更可能是正确的选择。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: So far we've cut the Standard Graduation Speech down from "don't give up on your dreams" to "what someone else can do, you can do." But it needs to be cut still further.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 到这里，我们已把标准毕业演说从‘不要放弃梦想’改成了‘别人能做的，你也能做。’但还需要进一步修正。

alignedParts.en: So far we've cut the Standard Graduation Speech down from "don't give up on your dreams" to "what someone else can do, you can do."
alignedParts.cn: 到这里，我们已把标准毕业演说从‘不要放弃梦想’改成了‘别人能做的，你也能做。’

alignedParts.en: But it needs to be cut still further.
alignedParts.cn: 但还需要进一步修正。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: There is some variation in natural ability.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 天生的能力多多少少有差异。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Most people overestimate its role, but it does exist.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 虽然很多人都高估了它，但确实存在。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: If I were talking to a guy four feet tall whose ambition was to play in the NBA, I'd feel pretty stupid saying, you can do anything if you really try. [2]
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 如果一个身高只有四英尺的人，志向是去NBA打球，我再对他说“只要真心努力，你什么都能做到”，就会觉得自己很傻。[2]

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: We need to cut the Standard Graduation Speech down to, "what someone else with your abilities can do, you can do; and don't underestimate your abilities." But as so often happens, the closer you get to the truth, the messier your sentence gets.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 我们需要把标准毕业演说改成：‘和你能力相当的人能做到的，你也能做到；而且不要低估自己的能力。’但就像常有的情况一样，越接近真相，句子就越不简洁。

alignedParts.en: We need to cut the Standard Graduation Speech down to, "what someone else with your abilities can do, you can do; and don't underestimate your abilities."
alignedParts.cn: 我们需要把标准毕业演说改成：‘和你能力相当的人能做到的，你也能做到；而且不要低估自己的能力。’

alignedParts.en: But as so often happens, the closer you get to the truth, the messier your sentence gets.
alignedParts.cn: 但就像常有的情况一样，越接近真相，句子就越不简洁。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: We've taken a nice, neat (but wrong) slogan, and churned it up like a mud puddle.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 我们把一个优美简洁(但错误)的口号，搅拌成了一堆烂泥。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: It doesn't make a very good speech anymore.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 但没有把这个演讲变得更好。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: But worse still, it doesn't tell you what to do anymore.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 更糟的是，它仍然没有告诉你该做什么。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Someone with your abilities?
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 一个和你能力相当的人？

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: What are your abilities?
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 你的能力究竟是什么？

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: I think the solution is to work in the other direction.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 我想，解决的方案是反方向去行动。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Instead of working back from a goal, work forward from promising situations.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 与其从一个目标倒退着去行动，不如一直往有前途的方向前进。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: This is what most successful people actually do anyway.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 这其实也是大多数成功者的做法。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: In the graduation-speech approach, you decide where you want to be in twenty years, and then ask: what should I do now to get there?
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 按照毕业演说的思路，你先决定二十年后要到达哪里，再问：为了到那里，我现在应该做什么？

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: I propose instead that you don't commit to anything in the future, but just look at the options available now, and choose those that will give you the most promising range of options afterward.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 我建议你不要对未来做出任何承诺，而是看看目前有哪些选项，然后挑那些能让你前途最广阔的选项。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: It's not so important what you work on, so long as you're not wasting your time.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 你现在做什么并不重要，只要你没有在浪费时间。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Work on things that interest you and increase your options, and worry later about which you'll take.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 做那些最吸引你的事情，增加选项，之后再忧虑到底要选哪个。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Suppose you're a college freshman deciding whether to major in math or economics.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 假如你是大一新生，正在犹豫该修数学还是经济。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Well, math will give you more options: you can go into almost any field from math.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 那么，数学或者能给你更多的选择：修了数学后，你几乎可以进入任何领域。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: If you major in math it will be easy to get into grad school in economics, but if you major in economics it will be hard to get into grad school in math.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 如果你主修数学，你很容易去读经济方面的研究生。但如果你修的是经济，会很难考取数学方面的研究生。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Flying a glider is a good metaphor here.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 滑翔机在这里是个好比喻。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Because a glider doesn't have an engine, you can't fly into the wind without losing a lot of altitude.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 滑翔机没有发动机，因此逆风飞行时，会损失很多高度。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: If you let yourself get far downwind of good places to land, your options narrow uncomfortably.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 如果你离理想的着落地点太远的下风位置，你的选择余地就比较狭窄了。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: As a rule you want to stay upwind.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 所以作为原则，你要始终处于上风位。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: So I propose that as a replacement for "don't give up on your dreams." Stay upwind.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 所以我建议，替代“不要放弃你的梦想”的是“保持上风”。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: How do you do that, though?
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 那你怎么做呢？

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Even if math is upwind of economics, how are you supposed to know that as a high school student?
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 即使数学要比经济学占上风一点，你作为一个高中生又怎么能知道呢？

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Well, you don't, and that's what you need to find out.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 嗯，你确实不知道，这就是你要自己搞明白的。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Look for smart people and hard problems.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 去寻找聪明人和困难的问题。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Smart people tend to clump together, and if you can find such a clump, it's probably worthwhile to join it.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 聪明人倾向于扎堆，如果你能找到发现这样一个群体，那加入他们是值得的。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: But it's not straightforward to find these, because there is a lot of faking going on.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 但并不容易真的找到，因为这里有一些虚假的类似群体。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: To a newly arrived undergraduate, all university departments look much the same.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 对一个新来的大学生来说，所有的大学院系都看起来差不多。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: The professors all seem forbiddingly intellectual and publish papers unintelligible to outsiders.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 教授们看起来很有才智，发表了很多对外行来说无法理解的论文。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: But while in some fields the papers are unintelligible because they're full of hard ideas, in others they're deliberately written in an obscure way to seem as if they're saying something important.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 但当有些论文看起来难懂是因为它们遍布着复杂的想法时，另外一些论文故意写得很费解，让它们看起来像是在讲着很重要的东西。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: This may seem a scandalous proposition, but it has been experimentally verified, in the famous Social Text affair.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 这看起来是诽谤的主张，但实验性地被证明了，在著名的 Social Text 事件中。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Suspecting that the papers published by literary theorists were often just intellectual-sounding nonsense, a physicist deliberately wrote a paper full of intellectual-sounding nonsense, and submitted it to a literary theory journal, which published it.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 因为怀疑文学理论杂志社出版的论文都是一些看起来很高深的但毫无意义的东西，一个物理学家故意写了一篇看起来很高深但毫无意义的论文，发给了一个文学理论杂志社，杂志社发表了它。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: The best protection is always to be working on hard problems.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 最好的自我保护方法总是去钻研困难的问题。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Writing novels is hard.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 写小说是困难的。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Reading novels isn't.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 读小说不是。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Hard means worry: if you're not worrying that something you're making will come out badly, or that you won't be able to understand something you're studying, then it isn't hard enough.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 困难意味着焦虑：如果你并没有担心你做出来的东西会很糟糕，或者没有在担心理解不了正在学习的东西，那就不够难。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: There has to be suspense.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 焦虑是一定要有的。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Well, this seems a grim view of the world, you may think.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 所以，你或许想，这真是一个无情的世界。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: What I'm telling you is that you should worry?
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 我正在告诉你的是你应该焦虑吗？

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Yes, but it's not as bad as it sounds.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 是的，但并不像听起来那么糟糕。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: It's exhilarating to overcome worries.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 战胜焦虑是令人兴奋的。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: You don't see faces much happier than people winning gold medals.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 你不可能看见比获得奥运金牌的人更开心的笑脸了。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: And you know why they're so happy?
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 你知道他们为什么如此开心吗？

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Relief.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 压力的释放。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: I'm not saying this is the only way to be happy.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 我并不是在说这是唯一的开心方式。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Just that some kinds of worry are not as bad as they sound.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 只不过在说有些焦虑并不像听起来那么糟糕。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: In practice, "stay upwind" reduces to "work on hard problems." And you can start today.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 实际上，‘保持上风’可以归结为‘攻克难题’。你今天就可以开始。

alignedParts.en: In practice, "stay upwind" reduces to "work on hard problems."
alignedParts.cn: 实际上，‘保持上风’可以归结为‘攻克难题’。

alignedParts.en: And you can start today.
alignedParts.cn: 你今天就可以开始。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: I wish I'd grasped that in high school.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 我真希望自己高中时就明白这一点。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Most people like to be good at what they do.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 大多数人都希望擅长自己做的事。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: In the so-called real world this need is a powerful force.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 在所谓的现实世界里，这种需要是一股强大的动力。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: But high school students rarely benefit from it, because they're given a fake thing to do.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 但高中生很少能从中受益，因为安排给他们的并不是真正的事业。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: When I was in high school, I let myself believe that my job was to be a high school student.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 高中时，我让自己相信，我的工作就是当一名高中生。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: And so I let my need to be good at what I did be satisfied by merely doing well in school.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 因此，只要在学校表现好，我就满足了自己“要把事情做好”的需要。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: If you'd asked me in high school what the difference was between high school kids and adults, I'd have said it was that adults had to earn a living.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 如果你问高中时候的我，高中年纪的孩子和成人的区别是什么，我会说，成人需要谋生。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Wrong.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 错。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: It's that adults take responsibility for themselves.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 而是成人必须要为自己负责。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Making a living is only a small part of it.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 谋生只是一小部分。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Far more important is to take intellectual responsibility for oneself.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 远为重要的是，为自己的智力负责。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: If I had to go through high school again, I'd treat it like a day job.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 如果我重新回到高中时光，我会把它当做是白天的日常工作。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: I don't mean that I'd slack in school.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 我并不是说我会在学校混日子。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Working at something as a day job doesn't mean doing it badly.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 当做日常工作并不是说随便应付。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: It means not being defined by it.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 而是说不要被它局限了。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: I mean I wouldn't think of myself as a high school student, just as a musician with a day job as a waiter doesn't think of himself as a waiter.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 我意思是我不会认为自己仅仅是个高中生，像一个白天有份服务员工作的音乐家并不会把他自己当做服务员。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: [3] And when I wasn't working at my day job I'd start trying to do real work.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: [3]然后当我完成日常工作后，我开始我真正的工作了。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: When I ask people what they regret most about high school, they nearly all say the same thing: that they wasted so much time.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 当我问起人们对高中时期最后悔的事情的时候，他们所有人都在说着同样的事情：他们浪费了太多的时间。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: If you're wondering what you're doing now that you'll regret most later, that's probably it. [4]
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 如果你想知道你现在做的什么事情会是你以后最后悔的，那很可能是这个。[4]

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Some people say this is inevitable — that high school students aren't capable of getting anything done yet.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 有些人说这是不可避免的——高中生还没有能力做成什么事情呢。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: But I don't think this is true.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 但我认为不对。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: And the proof is that you're bored.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 证据是你开始感到无聊。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: You probably weren't bored when you were eight.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 你很可能八岁的时候从不感觉无聊。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: When you're eight it's called "playing" instead of "hanging out," but it's the same thing.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 当你八岁的时候，叫“玩耍”而不是“打发时间”，但事实上是同一个东西。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: And when I was eight, I was rarely bored.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 当我八岁的时候，我几乎从不无聊。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Give me a back yard and a few other kids and I could play all day.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 给我一片后花园和几个小伙伴，我能玩上一整天。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: The reason this got stale in middle school and high school, I now realize, is that I was ready for something else.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 我现在意识到了，在中学或高中感觉到无聊的原因是，我已经准备好干点其它事情了。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Childhood was getting old.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 童年已经老了。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: I'm not saying you shouldn't hang out with your friends — that you should all become humorless little robots who do nothing but work.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 我可不是说你不应该和你朋友出去玩打发时间——像机器般的不懂得开玩笑的整天工作着。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Hanging out with friends is like chocolate cake.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 出去和朋友浪就像巧克力蛋糕。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: You enjoy it more if you eat it occasionally than if you eat nothing but chocolate cake for every meal.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 比起你每一顿都吃巧克力蛋糕来说，你偶尔吃一吃可能更享受。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: No matter how much you like chocolate cake, you'll be pretty queasy after the third meal of it.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 不管你多么喜欢巧克力蛋糕，吃到第三顿的时候，你会感觉相当反胃。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: And that's what the malaise one feels in high school is: mental queasiness. [5]
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 这就是一个高中生能在学校里感觉到的那种无聊乏味：精神上的反胃。[5]

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: You may be thinking, we have to do more than get good grades.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 你或许在想，除了好成绩，我们还要做其它事情。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: We have to have extracurricular activities.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 我们有课外活动。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: But you know perfectly well how bogus most of these are.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 但你很清楚大多数这些课外活动多没意义。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Collecting donations for a charity is an admirable thing to do, but it's not hard.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 组织给慈善机构的捐钱活动很令人赞赏，但并不难。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: It's not getting something done.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 这并没有做成真正的事情。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: What I mean by getting something done is learning how to write well, or how to program computers, or what life was really like in preindustrial societies, or how to draw the human face from life.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 我说的做成真正的事情是说，学习如何把文章写好，或者如何编程，或者去了解工业时代之前的生活是怎样的，或者如何描绘生活中的人脸。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: This sort of thing rarely translates into a line item on a college application.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 这类事情很少能直接变成大学申请表上的一项。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: It's dangerous to design your life around getting into college, because the people you have to impress to get into college are not a very discerning audience.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 围绕着进入大学的目标，来规划你的人生很危险，因为你要去打动的人并不是很有洞察力的听众。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: At most colleges, it's not the professors who decide whether you get in, but admissions officers, and they are nowhere near as smart.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 在大多数大学，决定是否录取你的不是教授，而是招生人员；后者的才智远不能与教授相比。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: They're the NCOs of the intellectual world.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 他们是知识界的士官。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: They can't tell how smart you are.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 他们无法判断你到底有多聪明。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: The mere existence of prep schools is proof of that.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 大学预备学校的存在本身，就证明了这一点。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Few parents would pay so much for their kids to go to a school that didn't improve their admissions prospects.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 如果没有增加孩子的入学希望的话，很少的家长会为孩子付那么多钱去上预科学校。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Prep schools openly say this is one of their aims.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 预科学校公开地宣称，这就是他们的目标之一。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: But what that means, if you stop to think about it, is that they can hack the admissions process: that they can take the very same kid and make him seem a more appealing candidate than he would if he went to the local public school. [6]
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 但如果你停下来想的话，这意味着他们有办法对大学录取耍手段：他们能把同样的孩子，让他变成更有吸引力的候选人，比起他去上当地的公立高中来说。[6]

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Right now most of you feel your job in life is to be a promising college applicant.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 现在你们中大多数都会觉得生活中主要的职责，就是让自己成为更有前途的大学候选人。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: But that means you're designing your life to satisfy a process so mindless that there's a whole industry devoted to subverting it.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 但这意味着你正在让你的生活去取悦这样一个欠考虑的制度——有整套的产业链来愚弄它。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: No wonder you become cynical.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 难怪你成了愤世嫉俗的人。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: The malaise you feel is the same that a producer of reality TV shows or a tobacco industry executive feels.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 你的那种不适，与真人秀制作人或烟草业高管感受到的不适是一样的。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: And you don't even get paid a lot.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 而你甚至还拿不到高薪。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: So what do you do?
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 所以那该怎么做呢？

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: What you should not do is rebel.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 不应该做的是叛逆。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: That's what I did, and it was a mistake.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 这是当时我做的，但我觉得这错了。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: I didn't realize exactly what was happening to us, but I smelled a major rat.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 我当时并没有意识到正在发生什么，我只是感觉有东西不对劲。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: And so I just gave up.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 所以我干脆放弃了。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Obviously the world sucked, so why bother?
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 这个世界显然糟透了，何必费心？

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: When I discovered that one of our teachers was herself using Cliff's Notes, it seemed par for the course.
