gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 我发现我们的一个老师，他自己也在用小说精析(译者注：读这个就能应付考试，可以跳过教纲指定的原著)。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Surely it meant nothing to get a good grade in such a class.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 这意味着在这样的课程里取得好成绩毫无意义。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: In retrospect this was stupid.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 回想起来，这很愚蠢。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: It was like someone getting fouled in a soccer game and saying, hey, you fouled me, that's against the rules, and walking off the field in indignation.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 这好像某人在足球场上被坑了一把然后说，嘿，你坑了我，这是犯规的，然后愤怒地离开球场。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Fouls happen.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 犯规经常发生。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: The thing to do when you get fouled is not to lose your cool.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 当你被犯规的时候，不要失去你的风度。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Just keep playing.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 继续比赛。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: By putting you in this situation, society has fouled you.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 放在这里，社会对你“犯规”了。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Yes, as you suspect, a lot of the stuff you learn in your classes is crap.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 是的，就像你怀疑的那样，大部分你在课堂上学到的都是胡扯。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: And yes, as you suspect, the college admissions process is largely a charade.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 而且，就像你怀疑的那样，大学的录取也是一场戏。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: But like many fouls, this one was unintentional.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 但就像其它犯规一样，这个也是无意的。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: [7] So just keep playing.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: [7]所以要继续比赛。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Rebellion is almost as stupid as obedience.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 叛逆就像服从一样愚蠢。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: In either case you let yourself be defined by what they tell you to do.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 两种情况，要么你去做他们要你去做的，要么偏偏不去做，你都被局限了。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: The best plan, I think, is to step onto an orthogonal vector.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 我想最好的方法是，踏入一个正交向量。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Don't just do what they tell you, and don't just refuse to.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 不要仅仅去做他们告诉你的，也不要单纯地拒绝。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Instead treat school as a day job.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 相反，把学校当做日常工作。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: As day jobs go, it's pretty sweet.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 作为一份日常工作，它其实相当不错。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: You're done at 3 o'clock, and you can even work on your own stuff while you're there.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 下午三点就结束了，而且在学校时，你甚至也能做自己的事情。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: And what's your real job supposed to be?
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 那你真正的工作应该是怎样的呢？

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Unless you're Mozart, your first task is to figure that out.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 除非你是莫扎特这样的天才，否则首要的就是去弄明白。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: What are the great things to work on?
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 有什么值得做的伟大事业呢？

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Where are the imaginative people?
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 想象力丰富的人在哪里？

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: And most importantly, what are you interested in?
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 更重要地是，你的兴趣何在？

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: The word "aptitude" is misleading, because it implies something innate.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: “天资”这个词有点误导人，它暗示了某种天生的能力。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: The most powerful sort of aptitude is a consuming interest in some question, and such interests are often acquired tastes.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 最强大的天资就是对某些问题有着持续的兴趣，这样的兴趣往往是可以后天习得的。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: A distorted version of this idea has filtered into popular culture under the name "passion." I recently saw an ad for waiters saying they wanted people with a "passion for service." The real thing is not something one could have for waiting on tables.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 这个观念的一个扭曲版本，以‘激情’之名进入了流行文化。我最近看到一则服务员招聘广告，要求应聘者‘对服务充满激情’。我真正说的那种兴趣，并不是端盘子时能够拥有的。

alignedParts.en: A distorted version of this idea has filtered into popular culture under the name "passion."
alignedParts.cn: 这个观念的一个扭曲版本，以‘激情’之名进入了流行文化。

alignedParts.en: I recently saw an ad for waiters saying they wanted people with a "passion for service."
alignedParts.cn: 我最近看到一则服务员招聘广告，要求应聘者‘对服务充满激情’。

alignedParts.en: The real thing is not something one could have for waiting on tables.
alignedParts.cn: 我真正说的那种兴趣，并不是端盘子时能够拥有的。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: And passion is a bad word for it.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 激情这个词放在这里并不好。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: A better name would be curiosity.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 更好的名字是好奇。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Kids are curious, but the curiosity I mean has a different shape from kid curiosity.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 孩子们是好奇的，但我说的好奇心和孩子们的好奇心有一些外在的差异。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Kid curiosity is broad and shallow; they ask why at random about everything.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 孩子的好奇心虽宽却浅，他们对万事万物都随机性地问为什么。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: In most adults this curiosity dries up entirely.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 对大部分成年人，这样的好奇心都枯竭了。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: It has to: you can't get anything done if you're always asking why about everything.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 不得不这样：如果你一直对各种东西在问为什么，你无法完成任何事情。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: But in ambitious adults, instead of drying up, curiosity becomes narrow and deep.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 但对于有野心的成年人来说，好奇心没有枯竭，而是变得收缩和深入。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: The mud flat morphs into a well.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 泥塘变成了深井。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Curiosity turns work into play.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 好奇心把工作变成了游戏。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: For Einstein, relativity wasn't a book full of hard stuff he had to learn for an exam.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 对于爱因斯坦来说，相对论并不是一本复杂难懂的书，必须去学会好能应付考试。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: It was a mystery he was trying to solve.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 而是他尝试去破解的谜题。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: So it probably felt like less work to him to invent it than it would seem to someone now to learn it in a class.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 所以对他而言，去发明它，比起要在教室里学会这套理论的学生来说，更像游戏一些。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: One of the most dangerous illusions you get from school is the idea that doing great things requires a lot of discipline.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 另外一个你在学校里学到的危险错觉是，做出杰出的工作需要大量的自制力。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Most subjects are taught in such a boring way that it's only by discipline that you can flog yourself through them.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 大多数课程都是以很无聊的方式来教学，所以你不得不通过自制力来鞭策自己去通过。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: So I was surprised when, early in college, I read a quote by Wittgenstein saying that he had no self-discipline and had never been able to deny himself anything, not even a cup of coffee.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 所以当我刚进大学的时候，读到 Wittgenstein 说的一句话：他几乎毫无自制力，从来无法克制任何东西，哪怕尽管是一杯咖啡，我大为惊奇。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Now I know a number of people who do great work, and it's the same with all of them.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 现在我认识了很多做出杰出工作的人了，这对他们来说同样适用。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: They have little discipline.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 他们没有多少自制力。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: They're all terrible procrastinators and find it almost impossible to make themselves do anything they're not interested in.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 他们全都是超级可怕的拖延症患者，发现几乎没有办法让他们去做任何不感兴趣的事情。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: One still hasn't sent out his half of the thank-you notes from his wedding, four years ago.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 其中一位，四年前婚礼上分给他负责的那一半感谢信，到现在还没寄出去。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Another has 26,000 emails in her inbox.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 另一位邮箱里有 26000 封邮件。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: I'm not saying you can get away with zero self-discipline.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 我没有在说你可以一点自制力都没有。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: You probably need about the amount you need to go running.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 你需要的量能支撑你去跑步就行了。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: I'm often reluctant to go running, but once I do, I enjoy it.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 我通常很不愿意去跑步，但我一旦去跑了，我会乐在其中。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: And if I don't run for several days, I feel ill.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 如果我几天没跑，我会觉得自己病怏怏的。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: It's the same with people who do great things.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 这对做出杰出工作的人同样使用。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: They know they'll feel bad if they don't work, and they have enough discipline to get themselves to their desks to start working.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 如果不工作的话，他们知道自己会感觉很糟糕，同时他们有着足够的自制力让自己走到桌子前开始干活。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: But once they get started, interest takes over, and discipline is no longer necessary.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 但一旦他们开始干活，兴趣开始支配他们，不再需要自律。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Do you think Shakespeare was gritting his teeth and diligently trying to write Great Literature?
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 你觉得莎士比亚是在咬紧牙关、勤勤恳恳地努力创作“伟大文学”吗？

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Of course not.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 当然不。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: He was having fun.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 他在找乐子。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: That's why he's so good.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 这就是为什么他如此杰出。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: If you want to do good work, what you need is a great curiosity about a promising question.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 如果你想做出杰出的工作，所有你需要的是对一个很有前景的问题有着巨大的好奇心。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: The critical moment for Einstein was when he looked at Maxwell's equations and said, what the hell is going on here?
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 对爱因斯坦来说，关键时刻是他看着麦克斯韦方程组，心想：“这里到底是怎么回事？”

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: It can take years to zero in on a productive question, because it can take years to figure out what a subject is really about.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 需要很多年的时间全神贯注于一个有前景的问题，因为需要很多年来搞清楚一个课题究竟是探讨什么的。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: To take an extreme example, consider math.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 举个极端的例子，想想数学。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Most people think they hate math, but the boring stuff you do in school under the name "mathematics" is not at all like what mathematicians do.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 大多数人都认为他们讨厌数学，但你在学校里学的那个冠以“数学”之名的玩意儿和数学家研究的东西完全不同。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: The great mathematician G. H. Hardy said he didn't like math in high school either.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 伟大的数学家 G.H. Hardy 说他在中学时代也不喜欢数学。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: He only took it up because he was better at it than the other students.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 他去学仅仅是因为他比其他同学要更擅长些。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Only later did he realize math was interesting — only later did he start to ask questions instead of merely answering them correctly.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 直到后来他才意识到数学是有趣的——后来他才开始问问题，而不是仅仅去正确地回答它们。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: When a friend of mine used to grumble because he had to write a paper for school, his mother would tell him: find a way to make it interesting.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 当我的一个朋友过去因为他要写作业而嘀咕抱怨时，他妈妈告诉他：去找一个方法让写作业变得有趣。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: That's what you need to do: find a question that makes the world interesting.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 这也是你需要去做的：去找到一个问题，让世界变得有趣。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: People who do great things look at the same world everyone else does, but notice some odd detail that's compellingly mysterious.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 做出杰出工作的人和其他人看到的是同样的世界，但注意到了一些古怪的细节，那些细节有着难以抗拒的魔力。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: And not only in intellectual matters.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 然而不单单是知识上。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Henry Ford's great question was, why do cars have to be a luxury item?
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 亨利·福特的伟大问题是，为什么汽车一定要是奢侈品呢？

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: What would happen if you treated them as a commodity?
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 如果你把它们做成普通商品会怎么样？

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Franz Beckenbauer's was, in effect, why does everyone have to stay in his position?
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 贝肯鲍尔（足球皇帝）的问题是，为什么每个人都得留在自己的位置上呢？

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Why can't defenders score goals too?
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 为什么后卫就不能也进球呢？

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: If it takes years to articulate great questions, what do you do now, at sixteen?
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 如果需要很多年来精确表达伟大的问题，那 16 岁的你应该怎么做呢？

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Work toward finding one.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 努力去寻找一个。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Great questions don't appear suddenly.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 伟大的问题不会突然出现。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: They gradually congeal in your head.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 它们渐渐地凝结在你的脑中。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: And what makes them congeal is experience.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 让它们凝结的是经历。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: So the way to find great questions is not to search for them — not to wander about thinking, what great discovery shall I make?
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 所以去寻找伟大的问题的方法不是去故意寻觅他们——不是去想，我有没什么伟大的发现呢？

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: You can't answer that; if you could, you'd have made it.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 你不能回答；如果你能回答，你早就发现了。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: The way to get a big idea to appear in your head is not to hunt for big ideas, but to put in a lot of time on work that interests you, and in the process keep your mind open enough that a big idea can take roost.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 想让一个大想法出现在脑海里，方法不是四处寻找大想法，而是在感兴趣的工作上投入大量时间，同时保持足够开放的头脑，让大想法有机会落脚。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Einstein, Ford, and Beckenbauer all used this recipe.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 爱因斯坦、福特和贝肯鲍尔，用的都是这个办法。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: They all knew their work like a piano player knows the keys.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 他们很清楚他们的工作，就像钢琴家一样很清楚琴键。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: So when something seemed amiss to them, they had the confidence to notice it.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 如果看起来有什么差错的时候，他们有信心去把握住。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Put in time how and on what?
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 那投入大量时间去做什么以及怎么做呢？

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Just pick a project that seems interesting: to master some chunk of material, or to make something, or to answer some question.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 挑个自己感兴趣的项目就行了：精通一些知识，或者创造点东西，或者去解决某些问题。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Choose a project that will take less than a month, and make it something you have the means to finish.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 选一个不到一个月就能完成的项目，而且要确保你有条件把它做完。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Do something hard enough to stretch you, but only just, especially at first.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 做一件刚好能让你有所突破的难事，不要难得太过，尤其是刚开始时。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: If you're deciding between two projects, choose whichever seems most fun.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 如果你正在两个项目中抉择，去挑最有趣的那个。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: If one blows up in your face, start another.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 如果一个项目搞砸了，开始另外一个。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Repeat till, like an internal combustion engine, the process becomes self-sustaining, and each project generates the next one.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 持续如此，像内燃机一样，这过程是自我持续的，每个项目都孕育着下一个项目。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: (This could take years.)
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: （这需要好几年时间）

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: It may be just as well not to do a project "for school," if that will restrict you or make it seem like work.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 如果“为学校而做”会限制你，或让项目变得像苦差事，那么不把它当作学校项目来做，可能反而更好。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Involve your friends if you want, but not too many, and only if they're not flakes.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 愿意的话，可以邀请朋友加入，但人不要太多，而且只邀请靠谱的人。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Friends offer moral support (few startups are started by one person), but secrecy also has its advantages.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 朋友能提供精神支持，鲜有创业公司完全由一个人创立；不过，保密也有它的好处。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: There's something pleasing about a secret project.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 秘密进行一个项目，有一种特别的乐趣。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: And you can take more risks, because no one will know if you fail.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 而且，你能承担更多风险，因为就算失败，也不会有人知道。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Don't worry if a project doesn't seem to be on the path to some goal you're supposed to have.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 不要担心一个项目看起来没有在通向你最终的目标的道路上。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Paths can bend a lot more than you think.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 这道路可能远比你想象的更曲折。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: So let the path grow out the project.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 所以，让道路从项目中生长出来。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: The most important thing is to be excited about it, because it's by doing that you learn.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 最重要的是，你要对项目感到兴奋，因为你正是通过做它来学习的。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Don't disregard unseemly motivations.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 不要忽视看起来不好的动机。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: One of the most powerful is the desire to be better than other people at something.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 其中强大的一个动机是想要在某些方面胜过别人的愿望。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Hardy said that's what got him started, and I think the only unusual thing about him is that he admitted it.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: Hardy 说这就是让他开始去学数学的原因，我想这里唯一不同寻常之处就是他竟然承认了这一点。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Another powerful motivator is the desire to do, or know, things you're not supposed to.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 另外一个强大的动机是渴望去做或搞清楚你并没有要求去做或弄懂的。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Closely related is the desire to do something audacious.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 类似的动机还有渴望去做某些大胆放肆的事。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Sixteen year olds aren't supposed to write novels.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 没有人要求 16岁的人会写小说。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: So if you try, anything you achieve is on the plus side of the ledger; if you fail utterly, you're doing no worse than expectations. [8]
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 但如果你试了，任何你做成的都是给你加分了；如果最终失败了，你也不会比期望的更差。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Beware of bad models.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 小心坏榜样。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Especially when they excuse laziness.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 尤其是他们为懒惰找了借口的时候。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: When I was in high school I used to write "existentialist" short stories like ones I'd seen by famous writers.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 高中时，我曾模仿读过的著名作家作品，写一些“存在主义”短篇小说。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: My stories didn't have a lot of plot, but they were very deep.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 我的文章并没有很多情节，但它们内涵很深。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: And they were less work to write than entertaining ones would have been.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 而且，比起写引人入胜的故事，写这些故事更省力。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: I should have known that was a danger sign.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 我本应该知道这是一个危险的信号。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: And in fact I found my stories pretty boring; what excited me was the idea of writing serious, intellectual stuff like the famous writers.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 而且事实上我发现的文章相当无聊；当时让我兴奋的是，我在想我可以像那些著名作家一样写些严肃高深的东西。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Now I have enough experience to realize that those famous writers actually sucked.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 现在我有足够的经验说那些很有名气的作家其实真的很逊。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Plenty of famous people do; in the short term, the quality of one's work is only a small component of fame.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 很多名人都是如此；在短期内，作品质量只是决定名气的一个小因素。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: I should have been less worried about doing something that seemed cool, and just done something I liked.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 我本应该不那么担心自己写些看起来很酷的东西，去做自己喜欢的事。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: That's the actual road to coolness anyway.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 这才是通向“酷”的真正道路。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: A key ingredient in many projects, almost a project on its own, is to find good books.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 许多项目的一个关键环节，是找到好书；这本身几乎就算一个项目。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Most books are bad.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 大多数书都不好。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Nearly all textbooks are bad.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 几乎所有教科书都不好。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: [9] So don't assume a subject is to be learned from whatever book on it happens to be closest.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: [9]所以，不要以为随手最近的那本相关书，就是学习某个学科应该用的书。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: You have to search actively for the tiny number of good books.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 你不得不积极地去寻找一小部分的好书。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: The important thing is to get out there and do stuff.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 重要的是走出来去做东西。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Instead of waiting to be taught, go out and learn.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 与其等着被教，不如主动去学。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Your life doesn't have to be shaped by admissions officers.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 你的人生不该被招生办公室的老师决定。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: It could be shaped by your own curiosity.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 而应该被你自己的好奇心决定。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: It is for all ambitious adults.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 有野心的成年人就是这样的。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: And you don't have to wait to start.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 你不需要等待出发。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: In fact, you don't have to wait to be an adult.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 实际上，你不需要等待成为一个成年人。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: There's no switch inside you that magically flips when you turn a certain age or graduate from some institution.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 你身体里没有切换开关，等你到达某个年龄或者从某个机构毕业的时候，让你神奇地改变。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: You start being an adult when you decide to take responsibility for your life.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 当你决定为你的人生负责的时候，你就变为成年人了。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: You can do that at any age. [10]
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 在任何年龄，你都可以这么做。[10]

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: This may sound like bullshit.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 这听起来纯属屁话。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: I'm just a minor, you may think, I have no money, I have to live at home, I have to do what adults tell me all day long.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 你可能会想：我只是个未成年人，没有钱，得住在家里，整天听从大人的安排。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Well, most adults labor under restrictions just as cumbersome, and they manage to get things done.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 可是，大多数成年人也承受着同样繁重的限制，他们仍然设法把事情做成。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: If you think it's restrictive being a kid, imagine having kids.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 如果你觉得作为一个孩子有诸多约束的话，想想自己有孩子时。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: The only real difference between adults and high school kids is that adults realize they need to get things done, and high school kids don't.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 成年人和高中生孩子的唯一真正的区别是，成年人意识到了他们必须把事情搞定，但高中生没意识到。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: That realization hits most people around 23.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 这种领悟一般是在 23 岁的时候降临到大多数人身上。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: But I'm letting you in on the secret early.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 但我现在提前告诉你这个秘密。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: So get to work.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 所以，开始干吧。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Maybe you can be the first generation whose greatest regret from high school isn't how much time you wasted.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 或许你们可以成为高中毕业后不会遗憾浪费了如此多的时间的第一代人。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: [1] A doctor friend warns that even this can give an inaccurate picture.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: [1]一位医生朋友提醒我，即使去医院做志愿者，也可能让你形成不准确的印象。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: "Who knew how much time it would take up, how little autonomy one would have for endless years of training, and how unbelievably annoying it is to carry a beeper?"
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: “谁知道一个人需要如此多的时间，如此少的自由来去应对长年累月的医学培训，又有谁知道整天带着传呼机是多么难以置信的烦人？”

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: [2] His best bet would probably be to become dictator and intimidate the NBA into letting him play.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: [2]他最有希望的办法，大概是当上独裁者，再威胁NBA让他上场。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: So far the closest anyone has come is Secretary of Labor.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 迄今为止，最接近这种情况的人，做到的是劳工部长。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: [3] A day job is one you take to pay the bills so you can do what you really want, like play in a band, or invent relativity.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: [3] 白天的日常工作就是那些你能赚够钱养活自己去做你真正喜欢的事情，像在乐队里弹唱或者发明相对论。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Treating high school as a day job might actually make it easier for some students to get good grades.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 把高中当做日常工作或许对一些学生来说更容易去取得好成绩。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: If you treat your classes as a game, you won't be demoralized if they seem pointless.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 如果你把课堂当做一种游戏，当它们看起来毫无意义的时候你不会沮丧。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: However bad your classes, you need to get good grades in them to get into a decent college.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 然而无论你的课程多么糟糕，你需要取得好成绩来进入好大学。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: And that is worth doing, because universities are where a lot of the clumps of smart people are these days.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 这是值得做的，因为目前而言，大学是许多聪明人扎堆的地方。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: [4] The second biggest regret was caring so much about unimportant things.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: [4]第二个最大的遗憾就是太在乎根本不重要的东西。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: And especially about what other people thought of them.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 尤其是在乎其他人怎么看待你。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: I think what they really mean, in the latter case, is caring what random people thought of them.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 我想后者，他们的真正意思是，无论什么人对你的看法，你都在乎。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Adults care just as much what other people think, but they get to be more selective about the other people.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 成年人也在乎别的人咋想，但他们对别的人更加精挑细选。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: I have about thirty friends whose opinions I care about, and the opinion of the rest of the world barely affects me.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 我大概有三十个朋友的意见可以在乎，世界上其他人的意见很少能影响我。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: The problem in high school is that your peers are chosen for you by accidents of age and geography, rather than by you based on respect for their judgement.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 高中的问题在于，你的同伴是由年龄和地理位置的偶然性决定的，而不是你因为尊重他们的判断力而自己挑选的。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: [5] The key to wasting time is distraction.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: [5]浪费时间的关键在于分心。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Without distractions it's too obvious to your brain that you're not doing anything with it, and you start to feel uncomfortable.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 如果没有分心，对你的大脑来说你并没有在做什么事情，你开始感觉不舒服。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: If you want to measure how dependent you've become on distractions, try this experiment: set aside a chunk of time on a weekend and sit alone and think.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 如果你想测量下你多么依赖分心，尝试这个实验：拿出周末的一段时间，独自坐着思考。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: You can have a notebook to write your thoughts down in, but nothing else: no friends, TV, music, phone, IM, email, Web, games, books, newspapers, or magazines.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 你可以带一本笔记本记录想法，但除此之外什么都不要有：朋友、电视、音乐、电话、即时通讯、邮件、网络、游戏、书籍、报纸或杂志。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Within an hour most people will feel a strong craving for distraction.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 不用一个小时，大多数人都会对分心非常渴望。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: [6] I don't mean to imply that the only function of prep schools is to trick admissions officers.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: [6]我并不是说，大学预备学校的唯一作用就是蒙骗招生人员。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: They also generally provide a better education.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 他们通常也提供了更好的教育。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: But try this thought experiment: suppose prep schools supplied the same superior education but had a tiny (.001) negative effect on college admissions.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 但实验性地想想如果预科学校提供同样优越的教育，但对大学申请有很小(0.001)的负面影响。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: How many parents would still send their kids to them?
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 有多少家长愿意把他们的孩子送去呢？

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: It might also be argued that kids who went to prep schools, because they've learned more, are better college candidates.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 也有人可能会说，大学预备学校的学生学得更多，因此本来就是更好的大学申请者。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: But this seems empirically false.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 但这实际上是错的。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: What you learn in even the best high school is rounding error compared to what you learn in college.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 与大学里学到的东西相比，即使在最好的高中学到的内容，也不过相当于一点舍入误差。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Public school kids arrive at college with a slight disadvantage, but they start to pull ahead in the sophomore year.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 公立学校到大学有一点点的劣势，但他们在第二年的时候开始迎头而上。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: (I'm not saying public school kids are smarter than preppies, just that they are within any given college.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: （我没有在说公立学校的孩子都比预科学校的孩子更聪明，仅是说在同一所大学。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: That follows necessarily if you agree prep schools improve kids' admissions prospects.)
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 如果你同意预科学校增加了孩子被录取的希望，那么便会有这个结论。）

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: [7] Why does society foul you?
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: [7]为什么社会愚弄你呢？

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Indifference, mainly.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 主要是因为漠不关心。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: There are simply no outside forces pushing high school to be good.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 没有外在的力量来推动高中变得更好。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: The air traffic control system works because planes would crash otherwise.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 航空运输控制系统运行得很好，否则飞机会发生坠机。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Businesses have to deliver because otherwise competitors would take their customers.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 公司必须交付产品，否则竞争对手会夺走客户。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: But no planes crash if your school sucks, and it has no competitors.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 但如果你的学校很糟糕，不会坠机，也没有竞争对手。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: High school isn't evil; it's random; but random is pretty bad.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 高中并不是有罪的；它是随机的；随机的通常很糟糕。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: [8] And then of course there is money.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: [8]另外一个动机是钱。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: It's not a big factor in high school, because you can't do much that anyone wants.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 在高中并不是一个强大的因素，因为你还不能做很多人想要的东西。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: But a lot of great things were created mainly to make money.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 不过很多杰出的东西大体上都是为了钱才被创造出来的。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Samuel Johnson said "no man but a blockhead ever wrote except for money." (Many hope he was exaggerating.)
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 塞缪尔·约翰逊说：‘除了傻瓜，没有人会不为钱而写作。’（很多人希望他只是在夸张。）

alignedParts.en: Samuel Johnson said "no man but a blockhead ever wrote except for money."
alignedParts.cn: 塞缪尔·约翰逊说：‘除了傻瓜，没有人会不为钱而写作。’

alignedParts.en: (Many hope he was exaggerating.)
alignedParts.cn: （很多人希望他只是在夸张。）

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: [9] Even college textbooks are bad.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: [9]就连大学教科书也不好。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: When you get to college, you'll find that (with a few stellar exceptions) the textbooks are not written by the leading scholars in the field they describe.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 当你去大学的时候，你也会发现教科书（除了一些）并不是相关领域的前沿学者写的。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Writing college textbooks is unpleasant work, done mostly by people who need the money.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 写大学教科书不是一个愉快的工作，大体上是那些需要钱的人写的。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: It's unpleasant because the publishers exert so much control, and there are few things worse than close supervision by someone who doesn't understand what you're doing.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 不愉快是因为出版商施加了很多的限制，然而几乎没有什么东西比密切的又不懂你的工作的监管更糟糕了。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: This phenomenon is apparently even worse in the production of high school textbooks.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 高中教科书的出版中，这个现象就更严重了。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: [10] Your teachers are always telling you to behave like adults.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: [10]你们的老师总是告诉你们要表现得像个成年人。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: I wonder if they'd like it if you did.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 我想知道他们是否真的希望如此。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: You may be loud and disorganized, but you're very docile compared to adults.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 你们或许大声争吵没有纪律，但你们比起成年人来说温顺太多。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: If you actually started acting like adults, it would be just as if a bunch of adults had been transposed into your bodies.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 如果你们真的表现得像个成年人，像是一群成年人转移到你们的身体里。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Imagine the reaction of an FBI agent or taxi driver or reporter to being told they had to ask permission to go the bathroom, and only one person could go at a time.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 想象一下FBI特工或出租车司机或者记者被告知说，你们必须经过同意才能上厕所，而且必须每次去一个。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: To say nothing of the things you're taught.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 更不用说你被教的知识了。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: If a bunch of actual adults suddenly found themselves trapped in high school, the first thing they'd do is form a union and renegotiate all the rules with the administration.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 如果一群真正的成年人突然发现自己被困在高中里，他们做的第一件事，大概就是成立工会，与校方重新协商所有规则。

gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.en: Thanks to Ingrid Bassett, Trevor Blackwell, Rich Draves, Dan Giffin, Sarah Harlin, Jessica Livingston, Jackie McDonough, Robert Morris, Mark Nitzberg, Lisa Randall, and Aaron Swartz for reading drafts of this, and to many others for talking to me about high school.
gr-pg-what-youll-wish-youd-known.cn: 感谢 Ingrid Bassett、Trevor Blackwell、Rich Draves、Dan Giffin、Sarah Harlin、Jessica Livingston、Jackie McDonough、Robert Morris、Mark Nitzberg、Lisa Randall 和 Aaron Swartz 阅读本文草稿，也感谢许多其他人与我谈论高中生活。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: To do something well you have to like it.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 要把一件事做好，你必须喜欢它。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: That idea is not exactly novel.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 这个想法并不新鲜。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: We've got it down to four words: "Do what you love." But it's not enough just to tell people that.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 我们把它概括成四个英文单词：‘Do what you love（做你热爱的事）。’但只是这样告诉人们还不够。

alignedParts.en: We've got it down to four words: "Do what you love."
alignedParts.cn: 我们把它概括成四个英文单词：‘Do what you love（做你热爱的事）。’

alignedParts.en: But it's not enough just to tell people that.
alignedParts.cn: 但只是这样告诉人们还不够。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Doing what you love is complicated.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 做自己热爱的事并不简单。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: The very idea is foreign to what most of us learn as kids.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 这个观念本身，就与我们大多数人从小接受的教育格格不入。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: When I was a kid, it seemed as if work and fun were opposites by definition.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 我小时候觉得，工作和乐趣似乎天生就是对立的。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Life had two states: some of the time adults were making you do things, and that was called work; the rest of the time you could do what you wanted, and that was called playing.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 生活分成两种状态：有时大人让你做事，那叫工作；其余时间你可以做自己想做的事，那叫玩耍。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Occasionally the things adults made you do were fun, just as, occasionally, playing wasn't — for example, if you fell and hurt yourself.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 偶尔，大人让你做的事也很有趣；同样，玩耍偶尔也会不开心，比如摔倒受伤的时候。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: But except for these few anomalous cases, work was pretty much defined as not-fun.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 但除了这些少见的例外，工作基本上就等于不好玩。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: And it did not seem to be an accident.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 而且，这似乎不是偶然。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: School, it was implied, was tedious because it was preparation for grownup work.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 大人隐含的意思是：上学之所以枯燥，是因为它在为成年后的工作做准备。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: The world then was divided into two groups, grownups and kids.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 于是，世界被分成两类人：大人和孩子。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Grownups, like some kind of cursed race, had to work.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 大人像某种受了诅咒的族群，必须工作。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Kids didn't, but they did have to go to school, which was a dilute version of work meant to prepare us for the real thing.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 孩子不用工作，但必须上学；上学就是简化版的工作，用来为将来的真正工作做准备。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Much as we disliked school, the grownups all agreed that grownup work was worse, and that we had it easy.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 尽管我们不喜欢上学，大人却一致认为成年人的工作更糟，而我们已经很轻松了。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Teachers in particular all seemed to believe implicitly that work was not fun.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 尤其是老师，似乎都默认工作没有乐趣。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Which is not surprising: work wasn't fun for most of them.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 这并不奇怪：对他们中的大多数人来说，工作确实没有乐趣。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Why did we have to memorize state capitals instead of playing dodgeball?
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 为什么我们必须背诵各州首府，而不能去玩躲避球？

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: For the same reason they had to watch over a bunch of kids instead of lying on a beach.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 原因就和他们必须看管一群孩子、而不能躺在海滩上一样。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: You couldn't just do what you wanted.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 你不能想做什么就做什么。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: I'm not saying we should let little kids do whatever they want.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 我不是说应该让小孩子为所欲为。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: They may have to be made to work on certain things.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 有些事情，可能确实需要要求他们去做。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: But if we make kids work on dull stuff, it might be wise to tell them that tediousness is not the defining quality of work, and indeed that the reason they have to work on dull stuff now is so they can work on more interesting stuff later. [ 1 ]
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 但如果我们让孩子做枯燥的事，最好告诉他们：枯燥并不是工作的本质；事实上，现在做这些枯燥的事，正是为了将来能做更有趣的事。[1]

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Once, when I was about 9 or 10, my father told me I could be whatever I wanted when I grew up, so long as I enjoyed it.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 我大约九岁或十岁时，父亲曾告诉我，只要我喜欢，长大后想做什么都可以。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: I remember that precisely because it seemed so anomalous.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 我之所以记得那么清楚，正是因为这句话听起来太反常了。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: It was like being told to use dry water.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 那就像有人叫你使用干燥的水一样。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Whatever I thought he meant, I didn't think he meant work could literally be fun — fun like playing.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 无论我当时怎样理解他的话，都没想到他是说工作真的可以有趣——像玩耍一样有趣。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: It took me years to grasp that.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 我花了好多年才明白这一点。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: By high school, the prospect of an actual job was on the horizon.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 到了高中，真正参加工作已经是可以预见的事了。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Adults would sometimes come to speak to us about their work, or we would go to see them at work.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 大人有时会来给我们讲他们的工作，或者我们去看他们工作。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: It was always understood that they enjoyed what they did.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 大家总是默认，他们喜欢自己做的事。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: In retrospect I think one may have: the private jet pilot.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 现在回想起来，我觉得其中一个人可能确实喜欢：那位私人飞机飞行员。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: But I don't think the bank manager really did.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 但我不认为那位银行经理真的喜欢自己的工作。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: The main reason they all acted as if they enjoyed their work was presumably the upper-middle class convention that you're supposed to.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 他们都表现得喜欢自己的工作，主要原因大概是中上层阶级的惯例：你就应该喜欢它。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: It would not merely be bad for your career to say that you despised your job, but a social faux-pas.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 说自己厌恶工作，不仅不利于职业发展，也会被视为社交上的失礼。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Why is it conventional to pretend to like what you do?
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 为什么假装喜欢自己的工作会成为一种惯例？

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: The first sentence of this essay explains that.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 本文的第一句话就解释了这一点。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: If you have to like something to do it well, then the most successful people will all like what they do.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 如果必须喜欢一件事才能把它做好，那么最成功的人就都会喜欢自己做的事。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: That's where the upper-middle class tradition comes from.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 中上层阶级的这项传统，就是这么来的。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Just as houses all over America are full of chairs that are, without the owners even knowing it, nth-degree imitations of chairs designed 250 years ago for French kings, conventional attitudes about work are, without the owners even knowing it, nth-degree imitations of the attitudes of people who've done great things.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 就像美国各地的家里都有各种椅子，主人却不知道它们是两百五十年前为法国国王设计的椅子的多重仿制品一样，人们对工作的惯常态度，也是在不知不觉中对成就非凡之人的态度做出的多重模仿。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: What a recipe for alienation.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 这简直是在制造疏离感。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: By the time they reach an age to think about what they'd like to do, most kids have been thoroughly misled about the idea of loving one's work.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 到了开始思考自己想做什么的年纪，大多数孩子对“热爱工作”这个观念已经受到了彻底的误导。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: School has trained them to regard work as an unpleasant duty.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 学校训练他们把工作看成一种不愉快的义务。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Having a job is said to be even more onerous than schoolwork.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 据说，上班甚至比做功课还要辛苦。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: And yet all the adults claim to like what they do.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 可所有大人又都声称喜欢自己做的事。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: You can't blame kids for thinking "I am not like these people; I am not suited to this world."
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 你不能怪孩子们会想：“我和这些人不一样；我不适合这个世界。”

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Actually they've been told three lies: the stuff they've been taught to regard as work in school is not real work; grownup work is not (necessarily) worse than schoolwork; and many of the adults around them are lying when they say they like what they do.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 事实上，他们听到了三个谎言：学校里那些被教作“工作”的事情并不是真正的工作；成年人的工作不一定比功课更糟；身边很多大人说自己喜欢工作，其实是在撒谎。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: The most dangerous liars can be the kids' own parents.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 最危险的说谎者，可能正是孩子自己的父母。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: If you take a boring job to give your family a high standard of living, as so many people do, you risk infecting your kids with the idea that work is boring.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 如果你像很多人那样，为了让家人过上优裕的生活而选择一份无聊的工作，就可能把“工作很无聊”这个观念传给孩子。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: [ 2 ] Maybe it would be better for kids in this one case if parents were not so unselfish.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: [2]也许唯独在这件事上，父母不那么无私，反而对孩子更好。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: A parent who set an example of loving their work might help their kids more than an expensive house. [ 3 ]
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 父母以身作则地热爱自己的工作，可能比一栋昂贵的房子更能帮助孩子。[3]

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: It was not till I was in college that the idea of work finally broke free from the idea of making a living.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 直到上大学，我才终于把工作这个概念与谋生这个概念分开。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Then the important question became not how to make money, but what to work on.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 于是，重要的问题不再是怎样赚钱，而是要做什么工作。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Ideally these coincided, but some spectacular boundary cases (like Einstein in the patent office) proved they weren't identical.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 理想情况下，两者是一致的；但一些引人注目的特殊例子，比如在专利局工作的爱因斯坦，证明它们并不是一回事。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: The definition of work was now to make some original contribution to the world, and in the process not to starve.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 这时，我对工作的定义变成了：为世界做出某种原创的贡献，同时不让自己饿肚子。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: But after the habit of so many years my idea of work still included a large component of pain.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 但多年来形成的习惯，让我对工作的理解仍然包含着大量痛苦。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Work still seemed to require discipline, because only hard problems yielded grand results, and hard problems couldn't literally be fun.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 工作似乎仍然需要自律，因为只有难题才能带来重大的成果，而难题不可能真的有趣。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Surely one had to force oneself to work on them.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 人当然得强迫自己去解决它们。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: If you think something's supposed to hurt, you're less likely to notice if you're doing it wrong.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 如果你觉得一件事理应让人痛苦，那么做错时，你反而不容易察觉。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: That about sums up my experience of graduate school.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 这大致概括了我的研究生经历。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: How much are you supposed to like what you do?
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 你究竟应该有多喜欢自己做的事？

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Unless you know that, you don't know when to stop searching.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 如果不知道答案，你就不知道什么时候该停止寻找。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: And if, like most people, you underestimate it, you'll tend to stop searching too early.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 而如果你像大多数人一样低估了这种喜欢的程度，就容易过早停止寻找。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: You'll end up doing something chosen for you by your parents, or the desire to make money, or prestige — or sheer inertia.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 最后，你做的事可能是父母替你选的，也可能是赚钱的欲望、名望，或纯粹的惯性替你选的。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Here's an upper bound: Do what you love doesn't mean, do what you would like to do most this second .
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 先说上限：做自己热爱的事，并不等于做此时此刻最想做的事。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Even Einstein probably had moments when he wanted to have a cup of coffee, but told himself he ought to finish what he was working on first.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 即使爱因斯坦，大概也有想喝杯咖啡，却告诉自己应该先完成手头工作的时刻。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: It used to perplex me when I read about people who liked what they did so much that there was nothing they'd rather do.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 过去，读到有人如此喜欢自己的工作，以至于什么别的事都不想做时，我总是很困惑。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: There didn't seem to be any sort of work I liked that much.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 似乎没有哪种工作能让我喜欢到那种程度。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: If I had a choice of (a) spending the next hour working on something or (b) be teleported to Rome and spend the next hour wandering about, was there any sort of work I'd prefer?
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 如果可以选择：（a）接下来一小时做某项工作，或者（b）瞬间来到罗马，花一小时四处闲逛，有哪种工作会让我更愿意选择吗？

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Honestly, no.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 老实说，没有。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: But the fact is, almost anyone would rather, at any given moment, float about in the Caribbean, or have sex, or eat some delicious food, than work on hard problems.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 但事实上，在任意一个时刻，几乎所有人都宁愿在加勒比海漂游、享受性爱，或品尝美食，而不是解决难题。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: The rule about doing what you love assumes a certain length of time.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: “做你热爱的事”这条原则，预设了一个时间跨度。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: It doesn't mean, do what will make you happiest this second, but what will make you happiest over some longer period, like a week or a month.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 它并不是让你做此刻最开心的事，而是让你做在一段较长时间内——比如一周或一个月——最让你开心的事。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Unproductive pleasures pall eventually.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 不产生任何成果的享乐，最终都会令人厌倦。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: After a while you get tired of lying on the beach.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 躺在海滩上待久了，你也会腻。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: If you want to stay happy, you have to do something.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 要想持续快乐，你就得做点事情。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: As a lower bound, you have to like your work more than any unproductive pleasure.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 再说下限：你必须喜欢自己的工作，胜过任何不产生实际成果的享乐。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: You have to like what you do enough that the concept of "spare time" seems mistaken.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 你要喜欢自己做的事，喜欢到觉得“业余时间”这个概念本身都有点不对。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Which is not to say you have to spend all your time working.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 这并不是说，你必须把所有时间都用来工作。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: You can only work so much before you get tired and start to screw up.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 工作一段时间后，你总会疲倦，开始出错。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Then you want to do something else — even something mindless.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 这时你会想做些别的事，甚至是不需要动脑子的事。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: But you don't regard this time as the prize and the time you spend working as the pain you endure to earn it.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 但你不会把这段时间当成奖赏，也不会把工作时间看成为了换取奖赏而忍受的痛苦。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: I put the lower bound there for practical reasons.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 我把下限定在那里，是出于实际考虑。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: If your work is not your favorite thing to do, you'll have terrible problems with procrastination.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 如果工作不是你最喜欢做的事，你就会遭遇严重的拖延问题。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: You'll have to force yourself to work, and when you resort to that the results are distinctly inferior.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 你将不得不强迫自己工作，而一旦需要这样做，成果就会明显逊色。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: To be happy I think you have to be doing something you not only enjoy, but admire.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 我认为，要想快乐，你做的事不仅要让你喜欢，也要让你欣赏。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: You have to be able to say, at the end, wow, that's pretty cool.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 做完之后，你得能够说：“哇，这可真酷。”

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: This doesn't mean you have to make something.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 这并不意味着你一定要制造出什么东西。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: If you learn how to hang glide, or to speak a foreign language fluently, that will be enough to make you say, for a while at least, wow, that's pretty cool.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 学会驾驶悬挂式滑翔机，或流利地说一门外语，就足以让你至少在一段时间内感叹：“哇，这可真酷。”

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: What there has to be is a test.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 必须有某种检验成果的方式。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: So one thing that falls just short of the standard, I think, is reading books.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 因此，我认为读书就略微达不到这个标准。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Except for some books in math and the hard sciences, there's no test of how well you've read a book, and that's why merely reading books doesn't quite feel like work.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 除了一些数学和硬科学书籍，很难检验你究竟读得有多好，所以仅仅读书不太像是在工作。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: You have to do something with what you've read to feel productive.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 你得用读到的东西做些什么，才会觉得自己有所产出。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: I think the best test is one Gino Lee taught me: to try to do things that would make your friends say wow.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 我觉得最好的检验方法，是吉诺·李教给我的：试着做一些能让朋友惊叹“哇”的事。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: But it probably wouldn't start to work properly till about age 22, because most people haven't had a big enough sample to pick friends from before then.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 但这大概要到二十二岁左右才真正奏效，因为在此之前，大多数人接触过的人还不够多，选择朋友的范围还不够广。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: What you should not do, I think, is worry about the opinion of anyone beyond your friends.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 我认为，你不该在意朋友以外的人怎么看。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: You shouldn't worry about prestige.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 你不该在意名望。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Prestige is the opinion of the rest of the world.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 名望就是世上其他人对你的看法。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: When you can ask the opinions of people whose judgement you respect, what does it add to consider the opinions of people you don't even know? [ 4 ]
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 既然可以征询那些你尊重其判断力的人的意见，考虑素不相识之人的看法又能增加什么价值呢？[4]

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: This is easy advice to give.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 提出这条建议很容易。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: It's hard to follow, especially when you're young.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 照着做却很难，尤其是在你年轻的时候。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: [ 5 ] Prestige is like a powerful magnet that warps even your beliefs about what you enjoy.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: [5]名望就像一块强力磁铁，甚至会扭曲你对自己喜欢什么的判断。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: It causes you to work not on what you like, but what you'd like to like.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 它会让你去做的，不是你真正喜欢的事，而是你希望自己能喜欢的事。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: That's what leads people to try to write novels, for example.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 比如，这就是一些人想要写小说的原因。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: They like reading novels.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 他们喜欢读小说。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: They notice that people who write them win Nobel prizes.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 他们发现，写小说的人会获得诺贝尔奖。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: What could be more wonderful, they think, than to be a novelist?
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 于是他们想，还有什么比当小说家更美好的呢？

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: But liking the idea of being a novelist is not enough; you have to like the actual work of novel-writing if you're going to be good at it; you have to like making up elaborate lies.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 但仅仅喜欢“成为小说家”这个念头是不够的；想写得好，你必须喜欢实际写小说的过程，必须喜欢编造精巧的虚构故事。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Prestige is just fossilized inspiration.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 名望不过是凝固了的灵感。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: If you do anything well enough, you'll make it prestigious.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 任何事情，只要你做得足够出色，就能让它获得声望。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Plenty of things we now consider prestigious were anything but at first.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 今天我们认为很有声望的许多事，起初完全不是那样。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Jazz comes to mind — though almost any established art form would do.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 爵士乐就是一个例子，尽管几乎任何一种已经确立地位的艺术形式都可以说明这一点。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: So just do what you like, and let prestige take care of itself.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 所以，去做你喜欢的事，让名望顺其自然。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Prestige is especially dangerous to the ambitious.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 对有抱负的人来说，名望尤其危险。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: If you want to make ambitious people waste their time on errands, the way to do it is to bait the hook with prestige.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 如果想让有抱负的人把时间浪费在杂务上，就用名望来当鱼饵。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: That's the recipe for getting people to give talks, write forewords, serve on committees, be department heads, and so on.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 让人们去做演讲、写序言、担任委员会成员、当系主任等等，用的就是这个办法。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: It might be a good rule simply to avoid any prestigious task.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 干脆避开所有能带来名望的差事，或许是条好规则。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: If it didn't suck, they wouldn't have had to make it prestigious.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 如果它们本身不糟糕，人们也就不必拿名望来包装它们了。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Similarly, if you admire two kinds of work equally, but one is more prestigious, you should probably choose the other.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 同样，如果你同样欣赏两种工作，但其中一种更有声望，那么你大概应该选择另一种。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Your opinions about what's admirable are always going to be slightly influenced by prestige, so if the two seem equal to you, you probably have more genuine admiration for the less prestigious one.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 你对什么值得欣赏的判断，总会稍微受到名望的影响；因此，如果两者在你看来同样好，你很可能其实更欣赏名望较低的那一种。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: The other big force leading people astray is money.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 另一种让人误入歧途的强大力量，是金钱。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Money by itself is not that dangerous.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 金钱本身并没有那么危险。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: When something pays well but is regarded with contempt, like telemarketing, or prostitution, or personal injury litigation, ambitious people aren't tempted by it.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 当一份工作报酬丰厚，却被人鄙视，比如电话推销、卖淫或人身伤害诉讼时，有抱负的人不会被它吸引。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: That kind of work ends up being done by people who are "just trying to make a living." (Tip: avoid any field whose practitioners say this.) The danger is when money is combined with prestige, as in, say, corporate law, or medicine.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 最后从事这类工作的，是那些‘只是想谋生’的人。（提示：避开从业者会这么说的任何行业。）真正的危险在于金钱和名望结合，例如公司法或医学领域。

alignedParts.en: That kind of work ends up being done by people who are "just trying to make a living."
alignedParts.cn: 最后从事这类工作的，是那些‘只是想谋生’的人。

alignedParts.en: (Tip: avoid any field whose practitioners say this.) The danger is when money is combined with prestige, as in, say, corporate law, or medicine.
alignedParts.cn: （提示：避开从业者会这么说的任何行业。）真正的危险在于金钱和名望结合，例如公司法或医学领域。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: A comparatively safe and prosperous career with some automatic baseline prestige is dangerously tempting to someone young, who hasn't thought much about what they really like.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 对尚未认真思考自己真正喜欢什么的年轻人来说，一份比较安稳、收入优厚、又自带一定声望的职业，具有危险的诱惑力。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: The test of whether people love what they do is whether they'd do it even if they weren't paid for it — even if they had to work at another job to make a living.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 检验一个人是否热爱自己的工作，就看即使没有报酬，甚至必须另找一份工作谋生，他是否仍愿意做这件事。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: How many corporate lawyers would do their current work if they had to do it for free, in their spare time, and take day jobs as waiters to support themselves?
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 如果必须在业余时间免费做现在的工作，白天还要当服务员养活自己，有多少公司律师仍然愿意干？

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: This test is especially helpful in deciding between different kinds of academic work, because fields vary greatly in this respect.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 这个检验在选择不同学术领域时特别有用，因为各领域在这方面差异很大。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Most good mathematicians would work on math even if there were no jobs as math professors, whereas in the departments at the other end of the spectrum, the availability of teaching jobs is the driver: people would rather be English professors than work in ad agencies, and publishing papers is the way you compete for such jobs.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 即使没有数学教授的职位，大多数优秀数学家仍会研究数学；而在另一端的某些院系，教职机会才是驱动力：人们宁愿当英语教授，也不愿去广告公司工作，发表论文则是竞争这类职位的手段。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Math would happen without math departments, but it is the existence of English majors, and therefore jobs teaching them, that calls into being all those thousands of dreary papers about gender and identity in the novels of Conrad.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 即使没有数学系，数学研究也会存在；但正是英语专业的存在，以及由此产生的教学职位，才催生了成千上万篇研究康拉德小说中性别与身份的乏味论文。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: No one does that kind of thing for fun.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 没有人会因为觉得好玩而做这种事。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: The advice of parents will tend to err on the side of money.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 父母的建议往往会过分偏向赚钱。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: It seems safe to say there are more undergrads who want to be novelists and whose parents want them to be doctors than who want to be doctors and whose parents want them to be novelists.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 可以肯定地说，想当小说家却被父母要求当医生的大学生，比想当医生却被父母要求当小说家的大学生更多。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: The kids think their parents are "materialistic." Not necessarily.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 孩子觉得父母“物质”。其实未必。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: All parents tend to be more conservative for their kids than they would for themselves, simply because, as parents, they share risks more than rewards.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 所有父母在为孩子考虑时，往往比为自己考虑更保守，因为身为父母，他们分担的风险多于回报。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: If your eight year old son decides to climb a tall tree, or your teenage daughter decides to date the local bad boy, you won't get a share in the excitement, but if your son falls, or your daughter gets pregnant, you'll have to deal with the consequences.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 如果八岁的儿子决定爬一棵高树，或十几岁的女儿决定和当地的坏小子约会，你分享不到其中的兴奋；可如果儿子摔下来，或女儿怀孕了，你却得承担后果。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: With such powerful forces leading us astray, it's not surprising we find it so hard to discover what we like to work on.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 有这么多强大的力量把我们引向歧途，难以发现自己真正喜欢做什么，也就不足为奇了。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Most people are doomed in childhood by accepting the axiom that work = pain.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 大多数人在童年接受“工作等于痛苦”这条公理时，就已注定走偏。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Those who escape this are nearly all lured onto the rocks by prestige or money.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 逃过这一关的人，几乎又都被名望或金钱引向了礁石。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: How many even discover something they love to work on?
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 究竟有多少人，连自己热爱的工作都能发现呢？

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: A few hundred thousand, perhaps, out of billions.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 几十亿人中，也许只有几十万人。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: It's hard to find work you love; it must be, if so few do.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 找到热爱的工作很难；既然做到的人这么少，它肯定很难。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: So don't underestimate this task.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 所以，不要低估这项任务。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: And don't feel bad if you haven't succeeded yet.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 如果还没成功，也不必难过。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: In fact, if you admit to yourself that you're discontented, you're a step ahead of most people, who are still in denial.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 事实上，如果你能向自己承认不满意现状，就已经比仍在否认这一点的大多数人领先了一步。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: If you're surrounded by colleagues who claim to enjoy work that you find contemptible, odds are they're lying to themselves.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 如果周围同事声称喜欢某份你看不起的工作，他们很可能是在自欺欺人。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Not necessarily, but probably.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 不一定如此，但很有可能。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Although doing great work takes less discipline than people think — because the way to do great work is to find something you like so much that you don't have to force yourself to do it — finding work you love does usually require discipline.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 做出伟大的成果，其实没有人们想象的那么需要自律，因为诀窍是找到你足够喜欢、无需强迫自己就会去做的事；但找到热爱的工作，通常确实需要自律。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Some people are lucky enough to know what they want to do when they're 12, and just glide along as if they were on railroad tracks.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 有些人很幸运，十二岁时就知道自己想做什么，此后像沿着铁轨一样顺畅前行。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: But this seems the exception.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 但这似乎只是例外。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: More often people who do great things have careers with the trajectory of a ping-pong ball.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 更多成就非凡的人，职业轨迹倒像一颗来回弹跳的乒乓球。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: They go to school to study A, drop out and get a job doing B, and then become famous for C after taking it up on the side.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 他们入学学习甲，中途退学去做乙，后来又因为业余开始尝试的丙而出名。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Sometimes jumping from one sort of work to another is a sign of energy, and sometimes it's a sign of laziness.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 从一种工作跳到另一种，有时是精力充沛的表现，有时则是懒惰的表现。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Are you dropping out, or boldly carving a new path?
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 你是在逃避，还是在勇敢地开辟新路？

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: You often can't tell yourself.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 你自己也常常分不清。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Plenty of people who will later do great things seem to be disappointments early on, when they're trying to find their niche.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 许多后来取得非凡成就的人，在早期寻找适合自己的位置时，都曾让人失望。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Is there some test you can use to keep yourself honest?
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 有没有什么方法，能让你诚实地面对自己？

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: One is to try to do a good job at whatever you're doing, even if you don't like it.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 一种方法是，无论正在做什么，即使不喜欢，也努力把它做好。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Then at least you'll know you're not using dissatisfaction as an excuse for being lazy.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 这样，你至少知道自己没有把不满意当作偷懒的借口。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Perhaps more importantly, you'll get into the habit of doing things well.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 也许更重要的是，你会养成把事情做好的习惯。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Another test you can use is: always produce.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 另一种检验方法是：始终有所产出。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: For example, if you have a day job you don't take seriously because you plan to be a novelist, are you producing?
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 比如，你因为打算当小说家，而对日常工作不上心；那么，你有在创作吗？

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Are you writing pages of fiction, however bad?
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 你有没有写下一页页小说，哪怕写得很差？

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: As long as you're producing, you'll know you're not merely using the hazy vision of the grand novel you plan to write one day as an opiate.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 只要还在产出，你就能知道：自己没有仅仅把“将来要写一部伟大小说”的模糊愿景当作麻醉剂。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: The view of it will be obstructed by the all too palpably flawed one you're actually writing.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 因为你眼前正在写的那部缺点无比明显的小说，会挡住那个美好幻影。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: "Always produce" is also a heuristic for finding the work you love.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: “始终有所产出”也是寻找热爱工作的一个方法。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: If you subject yourself to that constraint, it will automatically push you away from things you think you're supposed to work on, toward things you actually like.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 如果你给自己设下这条约束，它就会自动把你从那些自以为应该做的事，推向你真正喜欢的事。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: "Always produce" will discover your life's work the way water, with the aid of gravity, finds the hole in your roof.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: “始终有所产出”会帮你找到一生的事业，就像水借助重力，最终找到屋顶上的漏洞一样。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Of course, figuring out what you like to work on doesn't mean you get to work on it.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 当然，弄清自己喜欢做什么，并不意味着你就能去做。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: That's a separate question.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 那是另一个问题。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: And if you're ambitious you have to keep them separate: you have to make a conscious effort to keep your ideas about what you want from being contaminated by what seems possible. [ 6 ]
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 如果你有抱负，就必须把两者分开：有意识地努力，不让“什么看起来可行”污染“自己想要什么”的判断。[6]

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: It's painful to keep them apart, because it's painful to observe the gap between them.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 把它们分开是痛苦的，因为正视两者之间的差距令人痛苦。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: So most people pre-emptively lower their expectations.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 所以，大多数人会预先降低自己的期望。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: For example, if you asked random people on the street if they'd like to be able to draw like Leonardo, you'd find most would say something like "Oh, I can't draw." This is more a statement of intention than fact; it means, I'm not going to try.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 比如，随便问路人是否想像达·芬奇那样画画，大多数人可能会说：‘哦，我不会画画。’这与其说是陈述事实，不如说是表明意图：我不打算尝试。

alignedParts.en: For example, if you asked random people on the street if they'd like to be able to draw like Leonardo, you'd find most would say something like "Oh, I can't draw."
alignedParts.cn: 比如，随便问路人是否想像达·芬奇那样画画，大多数人可能会说：‘哦，我不会画画。’

alignedParts.en: This is more a statement of intention than fact; it means, I'm not going to try.
alignedParts.cn: 这与其说是陈述事实，不如说是表明意图：我不打算尝试。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Because the fact is, if you took a random person off the street and somehow got them to work as hard as they possibly could at drawing for the next twenty years, they'd get surprisingly far.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 因为事实是，随便从街上找个人，让他在接下来的二十年里竭尽全力练习绘画，他会取得令人惊讶的进步。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: But it would require a great moral effort; it would mean staring failure in the eye every day for years.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 但这需要极大的意志力，意味着多年来每天都要直面失败。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: And so to protect themselves people say "I can't."
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 因此，人们为了保护自己，会说：“我做不到。”

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Another related line you often hear is that not everyone can do work they love — that someone has to do the unpleasant jobs.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 你还经常会听到一个相关说法：并不是每个人都能做热爱的工作，总得有人去做那些不愉快的工作。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Really?
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 真是这样吗？

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: How do you make them?
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 你要怎样强迫他们去做？

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: In the US the only mechanism for forcing people to do unpleasant jobs is the draft, and that hasn't been invoked for over 30 years.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 在美国，唯一能强迫人们从事不愉快工作的机制是征兵，而这项机制已经三十多年没有启用了。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: All we can do is encourage people to do unpleasant work, with money and prestige.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 我们能做的，只是用金钱和名望鼓励人们去做不愉快的工作。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: If there's something people still won't do, it seems as if society just has to make do without.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 如果仍然有些事情没人愿意做，社会似乎也只能在没有这些事情的情况下继续运转。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: That's what happened with domestic servants.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 家佣就是这样一个例子。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: For millennia that was the canonical example of a job "someone had to do." And yet in the mid twentieth century servants practically disappeared in rich countries, and the rich have just had to do without.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 几千年来，家佣一直是‘总得有人来做’的典型工作。可到了二十世纪中叶，富裕国家的家佣几乎消失了，有钱人也只能适应没有家佣的生活。

alignedParts.en: For millennia that was the canonical example of a job "someone had to do."
alignedParts.cn: 几千年来，家佣一直是‘总得有人来做’的典型工作。

alignedParts.en: And yet in the mid twentieth century servants practically disappeared in rich countries, and the rich have just had to do without.
alignedParts.cn: 可到了二十世纪中叶，富裕国家的家佣几乎消失了，有钱人也只能适应没有家佣的生活。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: So while there may be some things someone has to do, there's a good chance anyone saying that about any particular job is mistaken.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 所以，虽然可能有些事情确实必须有人做，但说某一份具体工作必定如此的人，很可能是错的。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Most unpleasant jobs would either get automated or go undone if no one were willing to do them.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 如果没有人愿意做，大多数不愉快的工作，要么会实现自动化，要么就不再有人去做。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: There's another sense of "not everyone can do work they love" that's all too true, however.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 不过，“不是每个人都能做自己热爱的工作”，还有另一层含义，而且千真万确。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: One has to make a living, and it's hard to get paid for doing work you love.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 人必须谋生，而靠自己热爱的工作获得报酬并不容易。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: There are two routes to that destination: The organic route: as you become more eminent, gradually to increase the parts of your job that you like at the expense of those you don't.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 通向这个目标有两条路：自然发展路线——随着声望和地位提高，逐渐增加工作中喜欢的部分，减少不喜欢的部分。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: The two-job route: to work at things you don't like to get money to work on things you do.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 双工作路线——靠不喜欢的事情赚钱，来支持自己做喜欢的事情。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: The organic route is more common.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 自然发展路线更常见。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: It happens naturally to anyone who does good work.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 对工作做得好的人来说，它往往自然而然地发生。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: A young architect has to take whatever work he can get, but if he does well he'll gradually be in a position to pick and choose among projects.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 年轻建筑师必须接受所有能接到的工作，但如果做得好，慢慢就能挑选项目了。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: The disadvantage of this route is that it's slow and uncertain.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 这条路线的缺点是缓慢而且不确定。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Even tenure is not real freedom.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 即使获得终身教职，也不等于真正自由。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: The two-job route has several variants depending on how long you work for money at a time.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 双工作路线有几个变体，取决于你每次为赚钱而工作的时间有多长。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: At one extreme is the "day job," where you work regular hours at one job to make money, and work on what you love in your spare time.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 一个极端是保留一份日常工作：在固定时间上班赚钱，在业余时间做自己热爱的事。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: At the other extreme you work at something till you make enough not to have to work for money again.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 另一个极端是先做某件事，直到赚够钱，此后再也不必为钱工作。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: The two-job route is less common than the organic route, because it requires a deliberate choice.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 双工作路线不如自然发展路线常见，因为它需要有意识地做出选择。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: It's also more dangerous.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 它也更危险。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Life tends to get more expensive as you get older, so it's easy to get sucked into working longer than you expected at the money job.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 随着年龄增长，生活开销往往越来越大，因此你很容易陷入为了赚钱而工作的状态，做得比原计划更久。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Worse still, anything you work on changes you.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 更糟的是，任何工作都会改变你。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: If you work too long on tedious stuff, it will rot your brain.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 枯燥的事做得太久，会让你的头脑逐渐钝化。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: And the best paying jobs are most dangerous, because they require your full attention.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 而报酬最高的工作最危险，因为它们需要你全神贯注。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: The advantage of the two-job route is that it lets you jump over obstacles.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 双工作路线的优势，是让你能跨越障碍。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: The landscape of possible jobs isn't flat; there are walls of varying heights between different kinds of work.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 职业世界并不是一片平地；不同类型的工作之间，隔着高低不一的墙。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: [ 7 ] The trick of maximizing the parts of your job that you like can get you from architecture to product design, but not, probably, to music.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: [7]尽量增加工作中喜欢的部分，这个办法能让你从建筑转向产品设计，却大概不能让你转向音乐。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: If you make money doing one thing and then work on another, you have more freedom of choice.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 如果靠做一件事赚钱，再去做另一件事，你就有更多选择自由。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Which route should you take?
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 你该走哪条路？

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: That depends on how sure you are of what you want to do, how good you are at taking orders, how much risk you can stand, and the odds that anyone will pay (in your lifetime) for what you want to do.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 这取决于：你对自己想做什么有多确定，是否擅长服从安排，能承受多大的风险，以及在你有生之年，有人愿意为你想做的事付费的可能性有多大。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: If you're sure of the general area you want to work in and it's something people are likely to pay you for, then you should probably take the organic route.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 如果你确定想从事的大致领域，而且这件事很可能有人愿意付费，那么大概应该选择自然发展路线。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: But if you don't know what you want to work on, or don't like to take orders, you may want to take the two-job route, if you can stand the risk.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 但如果你还不知道想做什么，或者不喜欢听命于人，并且能够承担风险，那么可以考虑双工作路线。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Don't decide too soon.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 不要太早做决定。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: Kids who know early what they want to do seem impressive, as if they got the answer to some math question before the other kids.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 很早就知道自己想做什么的孩子，看起来令人钦佩，仿佛比其他孩子更早解出了数学题。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: They have an answer, certainly, but odds are it's wrong.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 他们确实有了一个答案，但那个答案很可能是错的。

gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.en: A friend of mine who is a quite successful doctor complains constantly about her job.
gr-pg-how-to-do-what-you-love.cn: 我有个朋友，是一位相当成功的医生，却经常抱怨工作。
