gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: You do need to work on important problems, but almost everyone is too conservative about what counts as one.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 你确实需要解决重要问题，但几乎所有人对“重要”的定义都太保守了。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: And if there's an important but overlooked problem in your neighborhood, it's probably already on your subconscious radar screen.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 如果你身边有一个重要但被忽视的问题，它很可能已经出现在你潜意识的雷达上了。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: So try asking yourself: if you were going to take a break from "serious" work to work on something just because it would be really interesting, what would you do?
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 试着问自己：如果你要从“正经”工作中抽身，纯粹为了好玩去做点什么，你会做什么？

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: The answer is probably more important than it seems.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 答案可能比看起来重要得多。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Originality in choosing problems seems to matter even more than originality in solving them.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 选题的原创性比解题的原创性更重要。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: That's what distinguishes the people who discover whole new fields.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 这正是开创全新领域之人的独特之处。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: So what might seem to be merely the initial step — deciding what to work on — is in a sense the key to the whole game.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 因此，决定“做什么”这看似只是初始的一步，在某种意义上却是整场游戏的关键。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Few grasp this.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 很少有人理解这一点。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: One of the biggest misconceptions about new ideas is about the ratio of question to answer in their composition.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 关于新想法最大的误解之一，就是关于“问题”和“答案”的比例。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: People think big ideas are answers, but often the real insight was in the question.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 人们以为大想法是答案，但通常，真正的洞见在于问题。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Part of the reason we underrate questions is the way they're used in schools.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 我们低估问题，部分归咎于学校的教育方式。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: In schools they tend to exist only briefly before being answered, like unstable particles.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 在学校里，问题就像不稳定的粒子，刚出现就被答案消灭了。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: But a really good question can be much more than that.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 但一个真正的好问题远不止于此。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: A really good question is a partial discovery.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 一个好问题，本身就是部分的发现。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: How do new species arise?
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 新物种是如何产生的？

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Is the force that makes objects fall to earth the same as the one that keeps planets in their orbits?
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 让物体落向地球的力，和让行星保持在轨道上的力，是同一种力吗？

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: By even asking such questions you were already in excitingly novel territory.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 仅仅提出这样的问题，就已经进入了令人兴奋的全新领域。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Unanswered questions can be uncomfortable things to carry around with you.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 随身携带未解之谜可能会让人不舒服。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: But the more you're carrying, the greater the chance of noticing a solution — or perhaps even more excitingly, noticing that two unanswered questions are the same.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 但你带着的谜题越多，发现答案的机会就越大——甚至更令人兴奋的是，你会发现两个未解之谜原来是同一个问题。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Sometimes you carry a question for a long time.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 有些问题你可能要背负很久。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Great work often comes from returning to a question you first noticed years before — in your childhood, even — and couldn't stop thinking about.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 伟大的工作往往源于回归你多年前——甚至童年时——注意到的那个问题。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: People talk a lot about the importance of keeping your youthful dreams alive, but it's just as important to keep your youthful questions alive. [ 19 ]
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 人们常说要守护年轻时的梦想，但守护年轻时的问题同样重要。[19]

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: This is one of the places where actual expertise differs most from the popular picture of it.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 这是真正的专家与大众印象最不同的地方。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: In the popular picture, experts are certain.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 大众眼里的专家是确定的。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: But actually the more puzzled you are, the better, so long as (a) the things you're puzzled about matter, and (b) no one else understands them either.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 但实际上，你越困惑越好，只要：(a) 让你困惑的事很重要，且 (b) 没人懂它。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Think about what's happening at the moment just before a new idea is discovered.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 想一想新想法诞生前的那一刻。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Often someone with sufficient expertise is puzzled about something.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 通常是一个拥有足够专业知识的人对某事感到困惑。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Which means that originality consists partly of puzzlement — of confusion!
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 这意味着，原创性部分构筑于困惑之上！

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: You have to be comfortable enough with the world being full of puzzles that you're willing to see them, but not so comfortable that you don't want to solve them. [ 20 ]
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 你必须能够接受世界充满谜团，并愿意看见它们，但又不能接受它们一直无解。[20]

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: It's a great thing to be rich in unanswered questions.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: “富拥”未解之谜是件好事。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: And this is one of those situations where the rich get richer, because the best way to acquire new questions is to try answering existing ones.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 这是“富者越富”的场景之一，因为获取新问题的最好方法就是尝试回答旧问题。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Questions don't just lead to answers, but also to more questions.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 问题不仅通向答案，更通向更多的问题。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: The best questions grow in the answering.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 最好的问题是在回答的过程中长大的。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: You notice a thread protruding from the current paradigm and try pulling on it, and it just gets longer and longer.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 你注意到现有范式中露出了一个小线头，试着拉了一下，结果它越拉越长。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: So don't require a question to be obviously big before you try answering it.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 所以，别指望在动手前就确定一个问题是否足够“大”。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: You can rarely predict that.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 你很难预测。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: It's hard enough even to notice the thread, let alone to predict how much will unravel if you pull on it.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 能注意到线头已属不易，更别提预测拉出来会有多长了。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: It's better to be promiscuously curious — to pull a little bit on a lot of threads, and see what happens.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 最好保持一种“滥情”的好奇心（Promiscuously curious）——随处拉拉线头，看看会发生什么。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Big things start small.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 大事往往起于微末。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: The initial versions of big things were often just experiments, or side projects, or talks, which then grew into something bigger.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 许多宏大项目的初版只是一个实验、一个副业，或一次谈话。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: So start lots of small things.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 所以，多开几个小头。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Being prolific is underrated.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 多产（Prolific）被低估了。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: The more different things you try, the greater the chance of discovering something new.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 你尝试的东西越多，发现新事物的概率就越大。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Understand, though, that trying lots of things will mean trying lots of things that don't work.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 但要明白，尝试多意味着失败多。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: You can't have a lot of good ideas without also having a lot of bad ones. [ 21 ]
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 你不可能只拥有很多好主意，而不伴随着很多坏主意。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Though it sounds more responsible to begin by studying everything that's been done before, you'll learn faster and have more fun by trying stuff.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: [21]虽然“先把前人的研究都看完再动手”听起来更负责任，但 通过动手尝试，你学得更快，也更有趣。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: And you'll understand previous work better when you do look at it.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 而且等你回过头看前人的工作时，你会理解得更透彻。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: So err on the side of starting.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 所以，宁可贸然开始。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Which is easier when starting means starting small; those two ideas fit together like two puzzle pieces.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 当“开始”意味着“从小做起”时，这就更容易了；这两个理念就像两块拼图一样契合。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: How do you get from starting small to doing something great?
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 如何从小事变成大事？

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: By making successive versions.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 通过版本的迭代。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Great things are almost always made in successive versions.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 伟大的事物几乎都是迭代出来的。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: You start with something small and evolve it, and the final version is both cleverer and more ambitious than anything you could have planned.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 你从一个小东西开始，不断进化，最终版本将比你计划的任何东西都更聪明、更宏大。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: It's particularly useful to make successive versions when you're making something for people — to get an initial version in front of them quickly, and then evolve it based on their response.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 为人们创造产品时，不断做出新版本尤其有用：尽快把初版放到用户面前，再根据他们的反应改进。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Begin by trying the simplest thing that could possibly work.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 先尝试最简单、也有可能行得通的方案。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Surprisingly often, it does.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 出人意料的是，它往往真的行得通。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: If it doesn't, this will at least get you started.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 即使不行，至少也能让你开始行动。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Don't try to cram too much new stuff into any one version.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 别试图在一个版本里塞进太多新东西。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: There are names for doing this with the first version (taking too long to ship) and the second (the second system effect), but these are both merely instances of a more general principle.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 这在第一版叫“发版太慢”，在第二版叫“第二系统效应”（Second-system effect），但这都是同一个原则的体现。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: An early version of a new project will sometimes be dismissed as a toy.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 新项目的早期版本有时会被贬低为“玩具”。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: It's a good sign when people do this.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 如果有人这么说，那是好兆头。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: That means it has everything a new idea needs except scale, and that tends to follow. [ 22 ]
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 这意味着它具备了新想法所需的一切，除了规模，而规模往往随之而来。[22]

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: The alternative to starting with something small and evolving it is to plan in advance what you're going to do.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: “从小做起、持续进化”的对立面是“预先规划”。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: And planning does usually seem the more responsible choice.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 规划通常看起来更负责任。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: It sounds more organized to say "we're going to do x and then y and then z" than "we're going to try x and see what happens." And it is more organized ; it just doesn't work as well.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 说‘我们要先做甲，再做乙，最后做丙’，听起来比‘我们试试甲，看看会怎样’更有条理。它确实更有条理，只是效果没那么好。

alignedParts.en: It sounds more organized to say "we're going to do x and then y and then z" than "we're going to try x and see what happens."
alignedParts.cn: 说‘我们要先做甲，再做乙，最后做丙’，听起来比‘我们试试甲，看看会怎样’更有条理。

alignedParts.en: And it is more organized ; it just doesn't work as well.
alignedParts.cn: 它确实更有条理，只是效果没那么好。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Planning per se isn't good.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 规划本身不是好事。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: It's sometimes necessary, but it's a necessary evil — a response to unforgiving conditions.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 它有时是必要的，但是一种“必要的恶”——是对无情条件的妥协。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: It's something you have to do because you're working with inflexible media, or because you need to coordinate the efforts of a lot of people.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 是因为你使用的媒介不灵活，或者你需要协调大量人员，才不得不规划。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: If you keep projects small and use flexible media, you don't have to plan as much, and your designs can evolve instead.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 如果你保持项目小巧并使用灵活的媒介，你就不必做那么多规划，你的设计可以自由进化。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Take as much risk as you can afford.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 在你能承受的范围内，尽可能多冒险。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: In an efficient market, risk is proportionate to reward, so don't look for certainty, but for a bet with high expected value.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 在一个有效的市场里，风险与回报成正比。别寻求确定性，去寻求那些期望值高（High Expected Value）的赌注。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: If you're not failing occasionally, you're probably being too conservative.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 如果你没有偶尔失败，说明你太保守了。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Though conservatism is usually associated with the old, it's the young who tend to make this mistake.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 虽然保守通常与老年人联系在一起，但这往往是年轻人的通病。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Inexperience makes them fear risk, but it's when you're young that you can afford the most.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 经验不足让他们害怕风险，但 年轻正是你最输得起的时候。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Even a project that fails can be valuable.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 即使失败的项目也是有价值的。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: In the process of working on it, you'll have crossed territory few others have seen, and encountered questions few others have asked.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 在做的过程中，你穿越了无人涉足的领地，遇到了别人未曾问过的问题。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: And there's probably no better source of questions than the ones you encounter in trying to do something slightly too hard.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 没有什么比“试图解决稍稍超出能力范围的问题”更能产生好问题了。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Use the advantages of youth when you have them, and the advantages of age once you have those.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 年轻时利用年轻的优势，年老时利用年老的优势。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: The advantages of youth are energy, time, optimism, and freedom.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 年轻的优势：精力、时间、乐观、自由。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: The advantages of age are knowledge, efficiency, money, and power.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 年老的优势：知识、效率、金钱、权力。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: With effort you can acquire some of the latter when young and keep some of the former when old.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 努力在年轻时获取一些后者，在年老时保留一些前者。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: The old also have the advantage of knowing which advantages they have.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 年长者还有一个优势：他们清楚自己拥有哪些优势。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: The young often have them without realizing it.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 年轻人往往拥有优势，却没有意识到。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: The biggest is probably time.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 其中最大的优势，大概是时间。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: The young have no idea how rich they are in time.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 年轻人不知道，自己在时间上有多富有。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: The best way to turn this time to advantage is to use it in slightly frivolous ways: to learn about something you don't need to know about, just out of curiosity, or to try building something just because it would be cool, or to become freakishly good at something.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 利用时间的最好方式是稍微“挥霍”一下：出于好奇去学点没用的东西，或者纯粹为了耍帅造个东西，或者在某件小事上练到极致。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: That "slightly" is an important qualification.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: “稍微”是个重要的限定词。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Spend time lavishly when you're young, but don't simply waste it.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 年轻时要大方地花时间，但别浪费。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: There's a big difference between doing something you worry might be a waste of time and doing something you know for sure will be.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: “担心可能是浪费时间”和“明知是浪费时间”有天壤之别。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: The former is at least a bet, and possibly a better one than you think. [ 23 ]
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 前者至少是个赌注，而且往往胜算比你想的大。[23]

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: The most subtle advantage of youth, or more precisely of inexperience, is that you're seeing everything with fresh eyes.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 年轻（或者说缺乏经验）最微妙的优势是：你拥有一双新鲜的眼睛。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: When your brain embraces an idea for the first time, sometimes the two don't fit together perfectly.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 当你的大脑第一次接触一个概念时，有时它们并不完全契合。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Usually the problem is with your brain, but occasionally it's with the idea.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 通常问题出在你的大脑，但偶尔，问题出在概念上。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: A piece of it sticks out awkwardly and jabs you when you think about it.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 某个部分尴尬地凸出来，扎了你一下。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: People who are used to the idea have learned to ignore it, but you have the opportunity not to. [ 24 ]
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 习惯了这个概念的人学会了忽略它，但你有机会不忽略。[24]

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: So when you're learning about something for the first time, pay attention to things that seem wrong or missing.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 所以，当你初次学习某样东西时，留意那些看起来不对劲或缺失的地方。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: You'll be tempted to ignore them, since there's a 99% chance the problem is with you.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 你会倾向于忽略它们，因为 99% 的概率是你错了。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: And you may have to set aside your misgivings temporarily to keep progressing.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 为了继续学习，你可能得暂时把疑虑搁置。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: But don't forget about them.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 但别忘了它们。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: When you've gotten further into the subject, come back and check if they're still there.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 等你掌握了更多知识，回过头来检查它们是否还在。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: If they're still viable in the light of your present knowledge, they probably represent an undiscovered idea.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 如果还在，那可能就是一个未被发现的想法。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: One of the most valuable kinds of knowledge you get from experience is to know what you don't have to worry about.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 经验带来的最有价值的知识之一，是知道 什么不必担心。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: The young know all the things that could matter, but not their relative importance.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 年轻人知道所有可能重要的事情，但不知道权重的分配。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: So they worry equally about everything, when they should worry much more about a few things and hardly at all about the rest.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 所以他们对所有事都同样担心，而实际上他们应该极度关注少数几件事，忽略其余的。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: But what you don't know is only half the problem with inexperience.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 但不知道的东西，只是缺乏经验所带来问题的一半。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: The other half is what you do know that ain't so.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 另一半，是那些你自以为知道、其实并不正确的东西。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: You arrive at adulthood with your head full of nonsense — bad habits you've acquired and false things you've been taught — and you won't be able to do great work till you clear away at least the nonsense in the way of whatever type of work you want to do.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 成年时，你的脑子里塞满了废话——养成的坏习惯、被灌输的错误观念。在你清除掉那些阻碍你工作的废话之前，你无法成就卓越。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Much of the nonsense left in your head is left there by schools.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 脑子里的大部分废话是学校留下的。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: We're so used to schools that we unconsciously treat going to school as identical with learning, but in fact schools have all sorts of strange qualities that warp our ideas about learning and thinking.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 我们太习惯学校了，会不自觉地把上学等同于学习；但学校其实有各种奇怪的特征，扭曲着我们对学习和思考的认识。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: For example, schools induce passivity.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 比如，学校会让人变得被动。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Since you were a small child, there was an authority at the front of the class telling all of you what you had to learn and then measuring whether you did.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 从小就有权威告诉你学什么，然后测试你学没学。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: But neither classes nor tests are intrinsic to learning; they're just artifacts of the way schools are usually designed.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 但上课和考试并非学习的本质，它们只是学校设计的产物。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: The sooner you overcome this passivity, the better.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 越早克服这种被动性越好。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: If you're still in school, try thinking of your education as your project, and your teachers as working for you rather than vice versa.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 如果你还在上学，试着把教育看作 你的项目，老师是为你工作的，而不是反过来。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: That may seem a stretch, but it's not merely some weird thought experiment.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 这听起来可能有些牵强，但它不只是一个古怪的思想实验。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: It's the truth economically, and in the best case it's the truth intellectually as well.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 从经济关系上说，这就是事实；在最理想的情况下，从知识学习的角度说也是如此。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: The best teachers don't want to be your bosses.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 最好的老师并不想当你的老板。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: They'd prefer it if you pushed ahead, using them as a source of advice, rather than being pulled by them through the material.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 他们更希望你主动前进，把他们当作建议的来源，而不是被他们拖着学完整套内容。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Schools also give you a misleading impression of what work is like.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 学校还会让你对工作的实际样子产生误解。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: In school they tell you what the problems are, and they're almost always soluble using no more than you've been taught so far.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 在学校里，别人告诉你问题是什么，而这些问题几乎总能只用已经教过的知识解决。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: In real life you have to figure out what the problems are, and you often don't know if they're soluble at all.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 你必须自己找出问题是什么，而且往往不知道它是否有解。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: But perhaps the worst thing schools do to you is train you to win by hacking the test.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 最糟糕的是，学校训练你 通过“破解考试”来获胜。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: You can't do great work by doing that.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 你无法通过这种方式成就卓越。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: You can't trick God.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 你骗不了上帝（God / 自然规律）。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: So stop looking for that kind of shortcut.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 别再找捷径了。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: The way to beat the system is to focus on problems and solutions that others have overlooked, not to skimp on the work itself.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 击败系统的办法是专注于别人忽视的问题和解决方案，而不是在工作本身上偷工减料。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Don't think of yourself as dependent on some gatekeeper giving you a "big break." Even if this were true, the best way to get it would be to focus on doing good work rather than chasing influential people.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 不要觉得自己必须依赖某个把关者，给你一个‘重大机会’。即使真是这样，获得机会的最好办法，也应是专心做好工作，而不是追逐有影响力的人。

alignedParts.en: Don't think of yourself as dependent on some gatekeeper giving you a "big break."
alignedParts.cn: 不要觉得自己必须依赖某个把关者，给你一个‘重大机会’。

alignedParts.en: Even if this were true, the best way to get it would be to focus on doing good work rather than chasing influential people.
alignedParts.cn: 即使真是这样，获得机会的最好办法，也应是专心做好工作，而不是追逐有影响力的人。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: And don't take rejection by committees to heart.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 别把委员会的拒绝放在心上。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: The qualities that impress admissions officers and prize committees are quite different from those required to do great work.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 打动招生办或奖项评委的特质，与成就卓越所需的特质截然不同。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: The decisions of selection committees are only meaningful to the extent that they're part of a feedback loop, and very few are.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 选拔委员会的决定只有在作为反馈循环的一部分时才有意义，而这种情况极少见。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: People new to a field will often copy existing work.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 刚进入一个领域的人，常常会模仿已有的作品。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: There's nothing inherently bad about that.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 这本身并没有什么不好。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: There's no better way to learn how something works than by trying to reproduce it.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 想了解某样东西如何运作，没有比尝试复现它更好的方法。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Nor does copying necessarily make your work unoriginal.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 模仿也不一定意味着你的作品没有原创性。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Originality is the presence of new ideas, not the absence of old ones.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 原创性在于新想法的出现，而不在于旧想法的缺席。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: There's a good way to copy and a bad way.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 模仿有好的方式，也有坏的方式。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: If you're going to copy something, do it openly instead of furtively, or worse still, unconsciously.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 如果要模仿，就公开地模仿，不要偷偷摸摸，更不要在毫无察觉的情况下模仿。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: This is what's meant by the famously misattributed phrase "Great artists steal." The really dangerous kind of copying, the kind that gives copying a bad name, is the kind that's done without realizing it, because you're nothing more than a train running on tracks laid down by someone else.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 那句出处经常被误传的名言‘伟大的艺术家偷窃’，说的正是这个意思。真正危险、让模仿背上坏名声的，是无意识的模仿，因为那时你不过是一列在别人铺好的轨道上行驶的火车。

alignedParts.en: This is what's meant by the famously misattributed phrase "Great artists steal."
alignedParts.cn: 那句出处经常被误传的名言‘伟大的艺术家偷窃’，说的正是这个意思。

alignedParts.en: The really dangerous kind of copying, the kind that gives copying a bad name, is the kind that's done without realizing it, because you're nothing more than a train running on tracks laid down by someone else.
alignedParts.cn: 真正危险、让模仿背上坏名声的，是无意识的模仿，因为那时你不过是一列在别人铺好的轨道上行驶的火车。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: But at the other extreme, copying can be a sign of superiority rather than subordination. [ 25 ]
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 但在另一个极端，模仿也可能是超越的表现，而不是从属的表现。[25]

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: In many fields it's almost inevitable that your early work will be in some sense based on other people's.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 在许多领域，你的早期作品在某种程度上基于他人的作品几乎是不可避免的。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Projects rarely arise in a vacuum.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 项目很少凭空产生。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: They're usually a reaction to previous work.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 它们通常是对前人工作的某种回应。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: When you're first starting out, you don't have any previous work; if you're going to react to something, it has to be someone else's.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 刚起步时，你还没有自己的旧作品；如果要回应什么，就只能回应别人的作品。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Once you're established, you can react to your own.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 一旦站稳脚跟，就可以回应你自己的作品了。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: But while the former gets called derivative and the latter doesn't, structurally the two cases are more similar than they seem.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 虽然前者被称为“衍生品”而后者不是，但从结构上看，这两种情况比看起来要相似得多。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Oddly enough, the very novelty of the most novel ideas sometimes makes them seem at first to be more derivative than they are.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 奇怪的是，最新颖的想法，其新颖之处有时反而使它们最初看起来比实际更具衍生性。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: New discoveries often have to be conceived initially as variations of existing things, even by their discoverers , because there isn't yet the conceptual vocabulary to express them.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 新发现往往最初必须被构想为现有事物的变体——甚至对发现者本人也是如此——因为当时还不存在表达它们的全新概念词汇。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: There are definitely some dangers to copying, though.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 不过，模仿确实存在风险。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: One is that you'll tend to copy old things — things that were in their day at the frontier of knowledge, but no longer are.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 一种风险是你会倾向于模仿旧东西——那些在其时代处于知识前沿，但现在已不再前沿的东西。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: And when you do copy something, don't copy every feature of it.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 此外，当你模仿某样东西时，不要模仿它的每一个特征。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Some will make you ridiculous if you do.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 有些特征如果你照搬，会让你显得很荒谬。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Don't copy the manner of an eminent 50 year old professor if you're 18, for example, or the idiom of a Renaissance poem hundreds of years later.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 例如，如果你才18岁，不要模仿一位著名的50岁教授的举止；或者在几百年后模仿文艺复兴时期诗歌的措辞。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Some of the features of things you admire are flaws they succeeded despite.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 你所欣赏的事物，有些特征其实是缺陷；它们是克服了这些缺陷才取得成功的。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Indeed, the features that are easiest to imitate are the most likely to be the flaws.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 事实上，最容易模仿的那些特征，最有可能恰恰就是缺陷。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: This is particularly true for behavior.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 在行为举止上尤其如此。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Some talented people are jerks, and this sometimes makes it seem to the inexperienced that being a jerk is part of being talented.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 有些有才华的人很讨厌，这有时会让缺乏经验的人误以为，讨人厌是才华的一部分。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: It isn't; being talented is merely how they get away with it.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 事实并非如此；才华只是让他们能够这样做而不受惩罚。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: One of the most powerful kinds of copying is to copy something from one field into another.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 最强有力的模仿之一，是将某个领域的模式复制到另一个领域。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: History is so full of chance discoveries of this type that it's probably worth giving chance a hand by deliberately learning about other kinds of work.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 历史充满了这类偶然发现，所以值得我们可以通过刻意学习其他类型的工作，助“偶然”一臂之力。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: You can take ideas from quite distant fields if you let them be metaphors.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 如果你允许它们成为隐喻，你可以从非常遥远的领域汲取灵感。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Negative examples can be as inspiring as positive ones.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 反面教材和正面教材一样能给人以此启发。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: In fact you can sometimes learn more from things done badly than from things done well; sometimes it only becomes clear what's needed when it's missing.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 事实上，你有时从做得糟糕的事情中学到的，比从做得好的事情中学到的更多；有时只有当某样东西缺失时，你才清楚什么是必须的。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: If a lot of the best people in your field are collected in one place, it's usually a good idea to visit for a while.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 如果你所在领域的许多顶尖人物聚集在同一个地方，去那里待一段时间通常是个好主意。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: It will increase your ambition, and also, by showing you that these people are human, increase your self-confidence. [ 26 ]
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 这会提升你的抱负，也会让你看到这些人同样是普通人，从而增强自信。[26]

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: If you're earnest you'll probably get a warmer welcome than you might expect.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 如果你足够真诚，受到的欢迎可能会比预期更热烈。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Most people who are very good at something are happy to talk about it with anyone who's genuinely interested.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 大多数在某方面非常出色的人，都乐于与任何真正感兴趣的人讨论它。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: If they're really good at their work, then they probably have a hobbyist's interest in it, and hobbyists always want to talk about their hobbies.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 如果他们真的很擅长自己的工作，那么他们很可能对它有着业余爱好者般的热情，而业余爱好者总是想谈论他们的爱好。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: It may take some effort to find the people who are really good, though.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 不过，找到那些真正优秀的人可能需要费点功夫。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Doing great work has such prestige that in some places, particularly universities, there's a polite fiction that everyone is engaged in it.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 因为成就卓越拥有极高的声望，所以在某些地方——特别是大学里——存在一种“礼貌的虚构故事”，假装每个人都在从事卓越的工作。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: And that is far from true.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 但这远非事实。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: People within universities can't say so openly, but the quality of the work being done in different departments varies immensely.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 大学内部的人不能公开这么说，但不同部门所做工作的质量差异巨大。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Some departments have people doing great work; others have in the past; others never have.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 有些部门有人在做伟大的工作；有些部门过去有过；而有些部门从未有过。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Seek out the best colleagues.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 关于同事：寻找最好的同事。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: There are a lot of projects that can't be done alone, and even if you're working on one that can be, it's good to have other people to encourage you and to bounce ideas off.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 很多项目无法独自完成；即使你做的项目可以独立完成，有人鼓励你、与你交流碰撞想法，也是好事。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Colleagues don't just affect your work, though; they also affect you.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 同事不仅影响工作，更影响你。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: So work with people you want to become like, because you will.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 所以，和你想成为的人一起工作，因为你会变成他们。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Quality is more important than quantity in colleagues.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 在同事的选择上，质量重于数量。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: It's better to have one or two great ones than a building full of pretty good ones.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 有一两个非常出色的同事，胜过整整一栋楼里都只是相当不错的同事。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: In fact it's not merely better, but necessary, judging from history: the degree to which great work happens in clusters suggests that one's colleagues often make the difference between doing great work and not.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 事实上，看历史就知道，伟大工作往往成簇出现，这意味着同事往往是成败的关键。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: How do you know when you have sufficiently good colleagues?
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 怎样才知道你的同事已经足够优秀？

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: In my experience, when you do, you know.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 依我的经验，真有这样的同事时，你自己会知道。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Which means if you're unsure, you probably don't.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 这意味着如果你不确定，那你可能还没有。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: But it may be possible to give a more concrete answer than that.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 不过，也许可以给出一个更具体的答案。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Here's an attempt: sufficiently good colleagues offer surprising insights.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 试着这样说：足够优秀的同事，会提出令你惊讶的见解。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: They can see and do things that you can't.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 他们能看到并做到你无法做到的事。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: So if you have a handful of colleagues good enough to keep you on your toes in this sense, you're probably over the threshold.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 所以，如果你有几个能在这种意义上让你保持警觉的同事，你就可能已经跨过了那个门槛。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Most of us can benefit from collaborating with colleagues, but some projects require people on a larger scale, and starting one of those is not for everyone.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 我们大多数人都能从与同事的合作中受益，但有些项目需要更大规模的人员协作，启动这类项目并不适合所有人。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: If you want to run a project like that, you'll have to become a manager, and managing well takes aptitude and interest like any other kind of work.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 如果你想运作那样的项目，你就必须成为一名管理者，而管理像其他工作一样，需要天赋和兴趣。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: If you don't have them, there is no middle path: you must either force yourself to learn management as a second language, or avoid such projects. [ 27 ]
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 如果你不具备这些，就没有中间道路：你必须要么强迫自己将管理作为第二语言来学习，要么彻底避开此类项目。[27]

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Husband your morale.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 呵护你的士气（Morale）。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: It's the basis of everything when you're working on ambitious projects.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 当你致力于雄心勃勃的项目时，士气是基础。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: You have to nurture and protect it like a living organism.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 你必须像呵护生命体一样呵护它。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Morale starts with your view of life.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 士气源于你的人生观。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: You're more likely to do great work if you're an optimist, and more likely to if you think of yourself as lucky than if you think of yourself as a victim.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 如果你是乐观主义者，如果你觉得自己幸运而不是受害者，你更可能成就卓越。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Indeed, work can to some extent protect you from your problems.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 工作在某种程度上能保护你。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: If you choose work that's pure, its very difficulties will serve as a refuge from the difficulties of everyday life.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 如果选择的是纯粹的工作，工作本身的困难就能成为避开日常生活烦恼的庇护所。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: If this is escapism, it's a very productive form of it, and one that has been used by some of the greatest minds in history.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 如果这算逃避现实，那也是一种很有成效的逃避，历史上一些最伟大的头脑都曾采用过。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Morale compounds via work: high morale helps you do good work, which increases your morale and helps you do even better work.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 士气会通过工作产生复利：高士气帮助你做好工作，好工作又提高士气，让你做得更好。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: But this cycle also operates in the other direction: if you're not doing good work, that can demoralize you and make it even harder to.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 但这个循环也会反向运转：工作做不好，会打击士气，让你更难做好工作。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Since it matters so much for this cycle to be running in the right direction, it can be a good idea to switch to easier work when you're stuck, just so you start to get something done.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 所以，当你卡住时，转去做点容易的事，哪怕只是为了让那个正向循环转起来。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: One of the biggest mistakes ambitious people make is to allow setbacks to destroy their morale all at once, like a balloon bursting.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 别让挫折一次性摧毁你的士气。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: You can inoculate yourself against this by explicitly considering setbacks a part of your process.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 把挫折明确地视为过程的一部分。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Solving hard problems always involves some backtracking.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 解决难题总是包含“回溯”（Backtracking）。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Doing great work is a depth-first search whose root node is the desire to.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 成就卓越是一个 以欲望为根节点（Root node）的深度优先搜索（Depth-first search）。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: So "If at first you don't succeed, try, try again" isn't quite right.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 所以“如果第一次没成功，就试了再试”是不准确的。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: It should be: If at first you don't succeed, either try again, or backtrack and then try again.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 应该是：“如果第一次没成功，要么重试，要么回溯一步再试。”

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: "Never give up" is also not quite right.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: “永不放弃”也不完全对。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Obviously there are times when it's the right choice to eject.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 有时弹射逃生是正确选择。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: A more precise version would be: Never let setbacks panic you into backtracking more than you need to.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 更精确的版本是：别让挫折恐吓你，导致你回溯得比必要的更远。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Corollary: Never abandon the root node.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 推论：永远别抛弃根节点。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: It's not necessarily a bad sign if work is a struggle, any more than it's a bad sign to be out of breath while running.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 工作痛苦不一定是坏事，就像跑步喘不上气不一定是坏事一样。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: It depends how fast you're running.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 这取决于你跑得有多快。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: So learn to distinguish good pain from bad.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 要学会区分“好的痛苦”和“坏的痛苦”。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Good pain is a sign of effort; bad pain is a sign of damage.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 前者是努力的标志，后者是损伤的信号。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: An audience is a critical component of morale.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 观众 是士气的关键。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: If you're a scholar, your audience may be your peers; in the arts, it may be an audience in the traditional sense.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 如果你是学者，受众可能是同行；如果你从事艺术，受众则可能是通常意义上的观众。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Either way it doesn't need to be big.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 无论哪种，受众都不必很多。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: The value of an audience doesn't grow anything like linearly with its size.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 受众的价值，远不是随人数线性增长的。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Which is bad news if you're famous, but good news if you're just starting out, because it means a small but dedicated audience can be enough to sustain you.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 这对名人是坏消息，对刚起步的人却是好消息，因为一小群忠实的受众就可能足以支撑你。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: If a handful of people genuinely love what you're doing, that's enough.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 只要有少数人真心热爱你做的事，就够了。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: To the extent you can, avoid letting intermediaries come between you and your audience.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 尽可能避免让中间人隔在你和受众之间。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: In some types of work this is inevitable, but it's so liberating to escape it that you might be better off switching to an adjacent type if that will let you go direct. [ 28 ]
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 某些工作无法避免这种中间环节，但摆脱它是如此自由，以至于如果转到相邻类型的工作能让你直接面对受众，那可能反而更好。[28]

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: The people you spend time with will also have a big effect on your morale.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 你花时间相处的人也会对你的士气产生巨大影响。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: You'll find there are some who increase your energy and others who decrease it, and the effect someone has is not always what you'd expect.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 你会发现，有些人能增加你的能量，而有些人则会消耗它；这种影响往往并不符合你的预期。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Seek out the people who increase your energy and avoid those who decrease it.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 寻找那些能增加你能量的人，避开那些消耗你能量的人。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Though of course if there's someone you need to take care of, that takes precedence.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 当然，如果有你需要照顾的人（这属于责任），则另当别论。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Don't marry someone who doesn't understand that you need to work, or sees your work as competition for your attention.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 别和不理解你“必须工作”的人结婚、或者将你的工作视为争夺你注意力的对手的人结婚。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: If you're ambitious, you need to work; it's almost like a medical condition; so someone who won't let you work either doesn't understand you, or does and doesn't care.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 如果你野心勃勃，工作对你来说就像某种病症。如果伴侣不让你工作，要么是他们不懂你，要么是懂但不在乎。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Ultimately morale is physical.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 归根结底，士气也有身体层面的基础。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: You think with your body, so it's important to take care of it.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 你是在用身体思考，因此照顾好身体很重要。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: That means exercising regularly, eating and sleeping well, and avoiding the more dangerous kinds of drugs.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 锻炼、睡眠、饮食、以及远离那些较危险的药物，都很重要。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Running and walking are particularly good forms of exercise because they're good for thinking. [ 29 ]
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 跑步和散步尤其适合，因为它们有利于思考。[29]

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: People who do great work are not necessarily happier than everyone else, but they're happier than they'd be if they didn't.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 做出伟大成果的人，未必比所有其他人更快乐；但一定比他们自己没有做出成果时更快乐。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: In fact, if you're smart and ambitious, it's dangerous not to be productive.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 事实上，如果你聪明而且有抱负，没有产出是危险的。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: People who are smart and ambitious but don't achieve much tend to become bitter.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 聪明且野心勃勃的人，如果无所建树，往往会变得苦涩。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: It's ok to want to impress other people, but choose the right people.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 想要打动别人没问题，但要选对人。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: The opinion of people you respect is signal.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 你所尊重的人的意见，是有用的信号。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Fame, which is the opinion of a much larger group you might or might not respect, just adds noise.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 名声则是更大一群人的看法，你未必尊重这些人，它只会增加噪声。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: The prestige of a type of work is at best a trailing indicator and sometimes completely mistaken.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 一类工作的声望，充其量只是滞后指标，有时甚至完全错误。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: If you do anything well enough, you'll make it prestigious.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 任何事情，只要做得足够好，你就能让它获得声望。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: So the question to ask about a type of work is not how much prestige it has, but how well it could be done.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 所以，关于某种工作，你要问的问题不是它有多少声望，而是 它能被做得多好。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Competition can be an effective motivator, but don't let it choose the problem for you; don't let yourself get drawn into chasing something just because others are.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 不要被竞争驱使去追逐别人都在追逐的东西。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: In fact, don't let competitors make you do anything much more specific than work harder.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 竞争最好的作用是让你更努力，而不是帮你做选择。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Curiosity is the best guide.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 好奇心是最好的向导。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Your curiosity never lies, and it knows more than you do about what's worth paying attention to.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 你的好奇心从不撒谎，它比你更清楚什么值得关注。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Notice how often that word has come up.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 留意一下，“好奇心”这个词已经出现了多少次。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: If you asked an oracle the secret to doing great work and the oracle replied with a single word, my bet would be on "curiosity."
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 如果你向神谕询问做出伟大成果的秘密，而它只回答一个词，我会押“好奇心”。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: That doesn't translate directly to advice.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 但这不能直接转化为建议。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: It's not enough just to be curious, and you can't command curiosity anyway.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 光有好奇心不够，你也没法命令好奇心产生。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: But you can nurture it and let it drive you.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 但你可以呵护它，让它驱动你。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Curiosity is the key to all four steps in doing great work: it will choose the field for you, get you to the frontier, cause you to notice the gaps in it, and drive you to explore them.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 好奇心是做出伟大成果的四个步骤的关键：它帮你选择领域，带你到达前沿，让你注意到缺口，并推动你探索这些缺口。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: The whole process is a kind of dance with curiosity.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 整个过程，就像与好奇心共舞。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Believe it or not, I tried to make this essay as short as I could.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 不管你信不信，我已经尽力把这篇文章写短了。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: But its length at least means it acts as a filter.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 但它的长度至少起到了过滤器的作用。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: If you made it this far, you must be interested in doing great work.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 如果你读到了这里，你一定对成就卓越很感兴趣。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: And if so you're already further along than you might realize, because the set of people willing to want to is small.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 如果是这样，你已经比你意识到的领先了一大截，因为 愿意去“想要”的人并不多。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: The factors in doing great work are factors in the literal, mathematical sense, and they are: ability, interest, effort, and luck.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 做出伟大成果的因素，就是数学意义上的那些乘数：能力、兴趣、努力和运气。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Luck by definition you can't do anything about, so we can ignore that.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 运气按定义就是你无法控制的，所以可以先不考虑它。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: And we can assume effort, if you do in fact want to do great work.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 既然你想成就卓越，努力也是默认值。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: So the problem boils down to ability and interest.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 所以问题归结为：天赋 和 兴趣。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Can you find a kind of work where your ability and interest will combine to yield an explosion of new ideas?
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 你能找到那个让你的天赋和兴趣结合并引爆新想法的工作吗？

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Here there are grounds for optimism.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 我们要保持乐观。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: There are so many different ways to do great work, and even more that are still undiscovered.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 成就卓越的方式千千万，未被发现的更多。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Out of all those different types of work, the one you're most suited for is probably a pretty close match.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 在所有不同类型的工作中，最适合你的那一种，很可能与你非常契合。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Probably a comically close match.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 甚至契合得让人觉得不可思议。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: It's just a question of finding it, and how far into it your ability and interest can take you.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 问题只在于找到它，并看看你的天赋和兴趣能带你走多远。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: And you can only answer that by trying.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 你只有试了才知道。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Many more people could try to do great work than do.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 很多人本可以尝试，却止步不前。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: What holds them back is a combination of modesty and fear.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 阻碍他们的是 谦逊 和 恐惧 的混合体。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: It seems presumptuous to try to be Newton or Shakespeare.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 尝试成为牛顿或莎士比亚，似乎太自负了。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: It also seems hard; surely if you tried something like that, you'd fail.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 而且看起来太难；真去尝试，肯定会失败。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Presumably the calculation is rarely explicit.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 人们大概很少把这种权衡明确地想出来。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Few people consciously decide not to try to do great work.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 很少有人会有意识地决定，不去尝试做出伟大的成果。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: But that's what's going on subconsciously; they shy away from the question.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 而是潜意识里发生的——他们回避了这个问题。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: So I'm going to pull a sneaky trick on you.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 所以我要对你耍个花招。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Do you want to do great work, or not?
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 你想成就卓越，还是不想？

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Now you have to decide consciously.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 现在你必须有意识地做决定了。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Sorry about that.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 抱歉逼你一把。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: I wouldn't have done it to a general audience.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 如果是一般观众我不会这么做。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: But we already know you're interested.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 但我们知道，你感兴趣。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Don't worry about being presumptuous.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 别担心狂妄。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: You don't have to tell anyone.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 你不必告诉任何人。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: And if it's too hard and you fail, so what?
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 如果太难失败了，那又怎样？

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Lots of people have worse problems than that.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 很多人有比这更糟糕的问题。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: In fact you'll be lucky if it's the worst problem you have.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 事实上，如果这是你最大的问题，那你算幸运的。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Yes, you'll have to work hard.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 是的，你得努力工作。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: But again, lots of people have to work hard.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 但还是那句话，很多人都在努力工作。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: And if you're working on something you find very interesting, which you necessarily will if you're on the right path, the work will probably feel less burdensome than a lot of your peers'.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 如果你在做自己觉得非常有趣的事——若你在正确的道路上，这几乎是必然的——那这种工作大概率比你同龄人的工作要轻松得多。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: The discoveries are out there, waiting to be made.
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 那些伟大的发现就在那里，等待着被看见。

gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.en: Why not by you?
gr-pg-how-to-do-great-work.cn: 为什么不是你呢？
